description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生至機械相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation in one of the corporative mechanical engineering company, practice and learn the real operation of the mechanical engineering related fields. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 先修課程：3002012或負責教授同意。介紹各種不同分析方法（如能量法及Castigliano定理）、破壞理論、材料選用、可靠度概念、軸及軸承、離合器及煞車器、傳動元件(如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪)、軸聯接器、飛輪、彈簧等。
description.en:
Prerequisite: ME212 or Consent of Instructor Introduction to Analysis Methods (Energy method & Castigliano theorem), 
Failure Theory, Material Selection, Introduction to reliability, Shafts and Bearings, Clutches and Brakes, Power Transmission Elements (Belts, Chains, Gears), Couplings, Flywheels, and Springs.

syllabi.outline: 本課程的宗旨, 在於能夠對機械設計所涉及的機件或元件類型(索鏈、樑桿、二力構件、銷、制動器、摩擦輪等等), 除了認知與了解, 還能夠與機械力學、應用力學、靜力學、動力學、運動學和材料力學等相關的法則整合, 能夠進一步解析具有代表性的機件或元件所組成的構件設計中合理的力作用方式(大小、方向、位置), 以期待能夠應用在多樣化可實現的機械設計活動或任務, 有效地從事溝通、規劃、裕度與公差配合解讀、預測、測試和改善等的應用業務以及解決方案.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。(A)材料試驗：學習金相試片的準備及光學顯微鏡之觀察、材料顯微結構的認識、各種機械性質的試驗。(B)
固力實驗：(1)一般性實驗：樑的撓度試驗、圓桿扭轉實驗；(2)振動實驗：質量－阻尼－彈簧系統實驗(MCK)、樑之共振頻率實驗、軸之臨界轉速實驗；(3)應力分析實驗：應變計實驗、光彈性實驗；(4)動態量測實驗：機械振動性質測定實驗、動平衡實驗、工具機切削力測定實驗。
description.en: (A) Materials testing: metallographic test, optical microscopes, microscopic structure, and mechanical property. (B) Solid mechanics testing: (1) testing of deflection of beams, testing of a twisted circular shaft; (2) testing of vibration : mass-damping spring system, testing of resonance frequency, testing of critical speed on shaft. (3) testing of stress analysis : strain gage, photo-elasticity  (4) testing of dynamic measurement, the property of mechanical vibration dynamic balance, and cutting resistance on machine tool.

syllabi.outline:
(A)熱工實驗：能量轉換、熱之傳遞、對流及輻射、熱交換器、燃燒及燃料等之實驗。(B) 流力實驗：雷諾數實驗、管路摩擦實驗(損失係數)、管路能量損失實驗(90°彎管、小半徑彎管、大半徑彎管、突擴、突縮)、文氏管流量實驗、孔口板流量實驗、壓力量測實驗、堰流量實驗、pump性能曲線實驗、壓力中心實驗、風洞實驗(升力、阻力係數)。
(A) Thermal Lab.

Thermal experiments include energy transformation, heat conduction, convection, and radiation, heat exchanger, combustion, etc. 

(B) Fluid Mechanics Lab.

Reynolds’s Number test, Pipe friction test (loss coefficient), Pipe energy loss test (90°miter, elbow, sudden enlargement and contraction), Venturi meter flow measurement, Orifice flow measurement, Pressure measurement, Wear flow measurement, Pump performance test, Pressure center test, Wind tunnel experiments (lift and drag coefficient).

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。(A)材料試驗：學習金相試片的準備及光學顯微鏡之觀察、材料顯微結構的認識、各種機械性質的試驗。(B)
固力實驗：(1)一般性實驗：樑的撓度試驗、圓桿扭轉實驗；(2)振動實驗：質量－阻尼－彈簧系統實驗(MCK)、樑之共振頻率實驗、軸之臨界轉速實驗；(3)應力分析實驗：應變計實驗、光彈性實驗；(4)動態量測實驗：機械振動性質測定實驗、動平衡實驗、工具機切削力測定實驗。

description.zh: 探討各種電機特性及工作原理，內容包含：(1)磁路分析(2)電機-機械能量轉換 (3)繞組及氣隙磁動勢 (4)繞組電感及電壓方程式 (5)繞組因數 (6)直流機 (7)感應機 (8)同步機。
description.en: Course Title:Electric Machinery Description:Principles, Construction and Application of transformer, DC motors, DC generators, induction motors, induction generators, synchronous motors and synchronous generators.

syllabi.outline:
Discuss the theories and features of kinds of AC electric machines, including: (1)A Simple Loop in a Uniform Magnetic Field; (2) The Rotating Magnetic Field; (3) Induced Voltage and Torque in AC Machines; (4)Machine Power Flows and Losses; (5)Synchronous Machines; (6)Induction Motors.

探討各種電機特性及工作原理，內容包含：(1)均勻磁場之單一線圈 (2)旋轉磁場 (3)交流電機的感應電壓與轉矩 (4)電機功率潮流及損失 (5)同步電機 (6)感應電動機 。
syllabi.schedule:
Wk1: Course Introduction and Rules (課程簡介及上課規則)
Wk2~Wk5: AC Machinery Fundamentals(交流電機基本概念)
Wk6~Wk8: Synchronous Machines (同步電機)
Wk9: Midterm Exam (期中考)
Wk10: Midterm Commentary & Synchronous Machines (期中考後試題檢討及同步電機)
Wk11~Wk13: Synchronous Machines(同步電機)
Wk14~Wk17: Induction Motors(感應電動機)
Wk18: Final Exam (期末考)
syllabi.assessment: (一)．Midterm(期中考): 30%; (二)．Final(期末考): 30%;  (三)．Attendance, Discussion and so on(平時討論): 40%

description.en:
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal  flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.

syllabi.outline:
數學基礎簡介，轉換函數，訊號流程圖，實際系統數學模式之求得，狀態方程式，線性系統之穩定度分析，控制系統之時域分析，根值軌跡圖，控制系統之頻域分析，時域及頻域下之控制器設計。
Teaching Topics: Transfer function, time response, equivalent systems, stability, steady-state errors, root locus techniques, frequency response techniques, controller design, and state space approach

Week 18: Final Exam

description.zh: 任何計畫、產品或服務之壽命週期起始自需要分析，其次為決定需求和規格，接著為設計和執行，最後經由使用階段，在支援和維護下完成此計畫。而在進行經濟分析，應對貨幣之時間價值、投資報酬率、損益平衡、公司債券、現金流量、有效利率、最小成本壽命、通貨膨脹、成本估計、折舊、所得稅、資金成本、更新分析、敏感性分析和風險決策分析等要點，以求估計值之準確性、方案抉擇決策之正確性。

description.zh: 本課程在二技為2學分。人因工程旨在研究調查人類的能力、限制、行為和其他特性等知識，而應用於工具、設備、系統、任務、工作和環境等的設計，以提高人類生活品質及生產力。所探討的內容可歸納如下：人因工程的研究方法、人體設計、人員的感覺歷程、人員的資訊處理、人員的體力活動、人機介面設計、作業環境、安全與衛生等。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures.  And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity.  The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
Human factors and ergonomics is dedicated to discover and survey human beings’ capability, limit, behavior and other features. And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. This course includes research and scientific approaches, physical design, human beings' sensory process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.
The aim of this course is to inspire students for human factors science through evidence-based approaches in improving products and systems by considering human capabilities and needs (also socio-technical factors) when interacting with products & systems. In this course we step from theory to practical implementation.

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理實習。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course let the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

syllabi.outline: 加強本系大學部學生實務應用與動手實做之能力，規劃並建置品管實習教室，除現有基礎品管教具外，導入光學影像量測儀、3D列印、IoT感應器及電子產業品質管制相關檢測設備。旨在配合國內科技產業品管人才需求，培養具競爭力的製程技術與品質管理專才。兼顧品管相關學術理論與實務應用，期將學術與工業界結合以達到理論與實用並重之目標。

description.zh: 以實務性專題提供管理組學生獨立研究、設計、實驗之機會。
description.en: This course provides the students the opportunity to do the practical project independently.

description.zh: 課程講授家具結構之專業知識與應用技術，理論與實務並重。內容包括開發流程、產品工程、基本力學、木材特性、複合板特性、木材接合、機械扣件、框類家具結構特性、板類家具結構特性、殼類家具結構特性等。
description.en: This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. The contents include R&D procedure, product engineering, basic mechanics, characteristics of wood, characteristics of composite board,, wood joints, mechanical fasteners, characteristics of frame type furniture, characteristics of panel type furniture, characteristics of shell type furniture etc.

description.zh: 探討木材之物理及機械性質對於家具構造與製造品質之影響，並讓學生瞭解材料之組織構造以熟識家具用材之鑑定。終其目標在使學生認識材料進而善用材料。 介紹以木質材料為主之家具材料。內容含蓋木材之外觀特徵，組織構造，材料鑑識及其物理與機械性質對於家具構造和製造品質其間之關係等。
description.en: The macrostructure and microstructure of wood. Identification and uses of common Softwoods and Hardwoods. Physical and mechanical properties in relation to wood processing. Properties of other wood based materials such as particleboard, fiberboard, plywood, laminated wood related to their use in furniture manufacture also included.

description.zh: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

description.zh:
本課程教導學生了解木材塗裝專業知識與應用，主要包括:
1. 木材塗料的種類。
2. 木材塗裝方式的選擇，如何依照木材特性選用合適之塗裝方式。
3. 塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。
4. 不同塗裝方式在木材外觀與維護上之影響。
5. 塗膜缺陷與對策。
description.en:
This course will help students to understand what is wood coating and application, include : 
1. Wood coatings category.
2. How to choose best way of wood coating process. 
3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 
4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 
5. Coating defects and solution.

description.zh: 本課程係提供學生有關家具的成本觀念，如何估算、分析和控制家具製品之成本。其講授內容有：成本結構、成本估算、材料成本、人工成本、製造費用、銷售費用、總成本及單位成本與產品報價等。
description.en: This course is to provide students with the concept of cost of furniture, how to estimate, analyze and control the cost of furniture products. Its teaching content includes: cost structure, cost estimation, material cost, labor cost, manufacturing cost, sales expense, total cost, unit cost and product quotation.

description.zh: 本課程之主旨為探討木質材料在生活產品上的設計應用，著重在傳統木工技藝、機械加工上的技能訓練，並培養學生在創新設計上的思維。更積極培養訓練學生以生活需求的觀點來創作木質材料產品，使學生能靈活運用各項木工基本機具設備製做各項木器產品。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to explore the design and application of wood materials in life products, focusing on traditional woodworking techniques, skills training on mechanical processing, and training students' thinking on innovative design. More active training and training students to create wooden materials from the perspective of living needs, so that students can use all kinds of woodworking basic machine equipment to make all kinds of wood products.

description.zh: 先修課程:負責教授同意學生與教授討論擬定專題研究的題目，在教授的個別指導下，進行實驗研究，並將研究結果寫成報告。
description.en: The topic of the special projects is discussed and together by the students and advisor. Under the face-to -face instruction of the advisor the student will conduct the research and experiments, and the final report at the end of the semester.

syllabi.outline: 學生與老師討論後，擬定專題製作的題目，在老師的個別指導下，進行研究操作，並將研究結果寫成報告。

description.zh: 實習操作車身矯正設備，肇事大、小變形車修理，車身校正，車身板件部份切換，以及封縫膠及防處理。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Using body working equipment, Collision repair, Body alignment, Body panel replacement and sectioning, and Sealer, adhesive, and anti-rust treatment.

description.zh:
先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車傳動系統及車身鈑噴實習，包含汽車車身及機車車架拆裝調整檢修，傳動系統元件拆裝調整檢修，車身測量，車身研磨、焊接及液壓施力設備之操作，金屬鈑金件之維修，車架及車身之校正及調整，門緣、車頭、玻璃及防潮條之更換，碰撞損壞之維修；塗裝及噴漆設備，塗裝及噴漆材料，配色技巧，車輛之塗裝及噴漆實際操作，完成品之品質檢驗。
95學年度前入學者適用下列實習內容: 車輛電系和可程式控制器，包括：引擎電系，充電系檢測，點火系檢測，電池之檢測與換裝，電腦控制系檢測，電腦診斷系統檢測，其他電控系統檢測；可程式控制器系統規劃，可程式控制器之整合與評估，可程式控制器應用。
description.en:
Automobile Drive Trains , Body Refinishing and Painting Service Shop Practice , Include the Repair, Overhaul and Trouble-Shooting of Automobile Transmission and Chassis, Automobile Body and Motorcycle Frame Assembly, Basic Dimensional Measurements, Inspection and Adjustments. The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .
For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , the practice contents are :
Electrical and Electronic System, Battery, Starting System, Charging System, Ignition System, Computer Control System, Computer Diagnostic System. Programmable logic controller (PLC) combi

description.zh: 柴油引擎-四行程柴油引擎、燃燒與燃燒室、燃料系統、預熱起動系統、電腦控制燃油噴射系統，汽車空調-冷氣基本作用原理、相關基礎熱力學、冷媒及冷凍油、汽車冷氣系統構造、汽車冷氣電路、汽車自動空調系統，汽車專業英文。
description.en: Diesel Engines include Four-Stroke Diesel engine, Combustion and combustion chamber, Fuel systems, Pre-Heat starting systems and Computer control fuel injection systems; Auto Air Condition Systems include Fundamental theory, Basic thermodynamics, Refrigerant and refrigerant oil, Construction, Electrical circuits and automatic air condition systems; Basic English for automotive service .

name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Technology (II)

description.zh: 課程包含識圖與製圖，電腦輔助製圖，量具、畫線、切斷，彎曲，車身板金接縫與邊緣，車身材料，塗料組成、溶劑、稀釋液，塗料樹脂種類與乾燥、硬化原理，塗裝研磨材料，塗裝遮蔽用材料，拋光用研磨膏及保護臘，以及汽車塗裝美容用材料之介紹。
description.en: The course includes the following topics: Learning to read and make design drawings, Computer-aided drafting, Measurement systems, line drawing, and cutting, Bending, Body sheet metal seaming and hemming, Body materials, Paints, solvents, and thinners, Paint resin and curing, Paint abrasives, Masking materials, Polishing paste and protection wax, and Vehicle cosmetic materials.

description.zh: 汽車材料的構成，金屬、非金屬、非鐵金屬、燒結合金及複合材料等在汽車分野上的應用，汽車材料的動向。
description.en: Compositions of Automotive Material，Applications of Metal、Nonmetal、Nonferrous Metal、Sintered Alloy、Composite materials for Automotive、Automotive Materia

description.zh:
先修課程:4402014或負責教授同意
柴油引擎概說，柴油之類別，特性與燃燒分析，柴油引擎與汽油引擎之比較，柴油引擎之類別與用途，柴油引擎之循環理論與工作分析，柴油引擎系統之主要構件、類別與特性分析，柴油引擎進排氣系統與環保控制裝置，柴油引擎之啟動設備，柴油引擎之其他配件與自動化，柴油引擎之特性數據與性能分析，柴油引擎之未來發展。
description.en: Diesel Engine Models, Combustion Analysis, Working Cycles Analysis, Major Components, Exhaust and Emission Control, Starting System, Performance Test and Analysis, Future Development.

description.zh: 底盤系統定期保養，輪胎平衡，四輪定位，變速箱分解檢查及故障排除。汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎量測與調整，引擎啟動、點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之定期保養檢測及故障排除。
description.en: Experiments on vehicle chassis, and transmission. Inspection, adjustment and repair of chassis system, tire balance, wheel alignment, overhaul and trouble-shooting of transmission. Gasoline & diesel engine assembly, engine test, engine tune-up and repair, trouble-shooting and instrument adjustment on: ignition system, fuel system, cooling system, lubrication system, and starting system.

description.zh: 車身研磨、焊接及液壓施力設備之操作，金屬鈑金件之維修，車架及車身之校正及調整，門緣、車頭、玻璃及防潮條之更換，碰撞損壞之維修；塗裝及噴漆設備，塗裝及噴漆材料，配色技巧，車輛之塗裝及噴漆實際操作，完成品之品質檢驗。
description.en: The practice of automobile body sanding, welding and hydraulic straightening equipment; repairing of the sheet-metal panels; frame and body alignment; door trim, headlinings, glass and weatherstripping replacement; repairing of the collision damages ; Automobile refinishing and painting equipment, refinishing and painting materials , color matching, the practice of refinishing and painting of the vehicle , painting quality testing .

description.zh: 實習素色調色(色相、明度、彩度)，珍珠銀粉色調色，三層珍珠色調色，小美容、以及全車大美容。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Plain paint blending (including hue, lightness, and saturation), Pearl silver-color blending, Pearl color paint mixing, Vehicle salon, and Full vehicle spa.

name.zh: 汽車板金及塗裝實習(六)

description.zh: 實習車身定位，車門、窗組件綜合檢修，汽車車體綜合檢修，以及汽車生產製造過程或維修服務實務參觀見學。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Vehicle body positioning, Doors and windows comprehensive check and repair, Full vehicle body overhaul, and Tours to learn vehicle manufacturing process and service.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh: 指導學生進行研究專題，以培育其研發能力。每一位學生必須經指導教授選定題目，獨立或數位同學成一組完成硬體或軟體專題，並書寫印製，經系公開展示與評分。
description.en: Teaching students to do the research work and to write the papers. Before graduation, the students have possessed the ability to do the R/D work. Each student must be through professor's instructions to select the topics of special project, personal or group work should be completed the project's hardware or software and issued the paper. An announcement has been made by the department, then get the grade and credit.

1. Compare and contrast the various forms of energy conversion.
2. Examine the technologies used to convert chemical energy into mechanical energy.
3. Apply the concepts of electrical converters.
4. Evaluate the major types of energy storage.
5. Determine how human values affect the success of energy conservation.
6. Design of new energy system modules with ecology considerations.

description.zh: 值此一網際網路和數位經濟時代，資料通訊與網路已經顯著影響企業經營、管理及決策與策略規劃同時也影響人們之生活及活動。 它的應用非常廣泛、無所不在且多元。 商業公司及企業可以運用資料通訊及網路化資訊系統來提升競爭優勢及執行績效、經營者決策及客戶服務效率與全球化商務、產品及服務。資料通訊可以在各種設置上以有線及無線的方式使用。因此，本課程的開課目標旨在學習並瞭解資料通訊及網路之基本原理、基礎建設、技術、管理及企業應用等之議題。本課程主要探討之主題包括 1)資料通訊基本原理、2) 資料傳輸技術、3)網路應用、4) 有線及無線區域網路、5) 有線及無線廣域網路、6)網際網路與TCP/IP、7) 網路安全、8)網路設計、9) 網路管理、10)分散資料處理、 11) 主從、內部網路與雲端運算、12) 第四代行動網路和往後世代等。
description.en: In this era of Internet economy, businesses and enterprises may leverage data communications (DC) and networked information systems to enhance competitive advantages, streamline managerial decision making, and customer services. DC may be adopted in a variety of devices on both wire and wireless modes. Consequently, the objectives of this course aim to study the issues of fundamentals, infrastructure, technologies, management and business applications on data communications and networks. The major topics of this course contains 1) Fundamentals of DC, 2) Technologies of data transmission, 3) Network applications, 4) Wired and wireless local area networks, 5) Wired and wireless wide area networks, 6) The Internet and TCP/IP, 7) Network security, 8) Design networks, 9) Network administration; 10) Distributed data processing, 11) Client/Server, Intranet, and cloud computing, 12) Fourth generation (4G) Mobile networks and onwards.

syllabi.outline:
以網際網路為本，介紹電腦網路基本概念與企業實務運作，奠定網路架構基礎，並說明資訊安全的重要性。

This course aims at teaching the basic, introductory networking topics as a firm foundation with the latest advances in wireless networking and providing the importance and ins and outs of information security as well.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹期貨、選擇權與相關衍生性金融商品的理論基礎與實務概念，了解衍生性金融商品在套利、避險與投機策略上的應用。課程內容包含期貨與選擇權兩個部分：在期貨議題方面，主要介紹期貨市場的組織結構、期貨契約的理論價格、以及避險策略；在選擇權議題方面，則是涵蓋選擇權市場的介紹、選擇權的理論價格、交易策略、與市場資訊分析。藉由對期貨與選擇權理論基礎的建構，期望能強化同學對於衍生性金融商品的實務應用能力。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce students to the theoretical and practical aspects of financial futures, options, and other derivatives. Derivatives have become one of the most important tools of modern finance, from both the academic and the practical standpoint. They are used for compensation, speculation, yield enhancements of investments, and, most importantly, for risk management. This course consists of two parts. The first part of the course deals with futures issues including the structure of futures markets, pricing of futures contracts, and hedging with such contracts. The second part of the course deals with options issues including options markets, strategies, pricing, and hedging analysis. Students will learn about the theoretical underpinnings and the practical applications in real world of derivative securities.

The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. description.en:
Course Title:Microprocessor
Description:This course introduces the working principles of computer.
It puts emphasis on both hardware and software, as well as both theory
and appplication. Basically, this course covers the introduction of
general microprocessors:their architecture and operation, Assembly
language program and module program, instruction addressing mode,
instruction operation, and I/O Program and interface. More
specifically, multi-programming configuration and multi-processing
configuration are also discussed here. New topics will be added if
needed.

syllabi.outline:
微處理器是各種需要高性能的電子產品中的主要元件之一，微處理器對目前與未來的電子工程師而言，日益重要。本課程將介紹近代微處理機之發展、微處理機架構、軟體環境、組合語言程式、硬體架構及周邊電路設計。課程將以x86/x64微處理器例，以綜合性的方式介紹處理器的一般原理，學習後可應用相同原理於其他類型的微處理器或嵌入式微處理器中。

Microprocessors are one of the major components of a wide variety of electronic products that require high performance, and microprocessors are increasingly important for current and future electronic engineers. This course will introduce the development of modern microprocessors, microprocessor architecture, software environment, assembly language programming, hardware architecture and peripheral circuit design. The course will introduce the general principles of processors in a comprehensive manner using x86/x64 microprocessor examples, and the same principles can be applied to other types of microprocessors or embedded microprocessors.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class.  This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. description.zh: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
The course introduces the properties of signals and systems, and is a fundamental course for those who are interested in communications, signal processing, control systems, and electronic circuits. The student will learn about the basic concepts of continuous-time and discrete-time signal processing. The covered topics are:

1. Signals and systems
2. Linear time-invariant systems
3. Fourier series representation of periodic signals
4. The continuous-time Fourier transform
5. The discrete-time Fourier transform
6. Sampling
7. Time and frequency characterization of signals and systems 
8. The Z-transform (optional)
9. The Laplace-transform (optional)

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.en: The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The course includes probability theory, testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Minitab. Minitab is widely used not only in engineering, but also in sciences, medicine, biology, physics, and business. It is assumed students have exposure to basic statistics and knowledge of calculus (i.e., differential and integral calculus). The main focus of the class will be on statistical analysis and graphics in Minitab. Students will cover basic statistical concepts and various statistical methods such as estimation, hypothesis tests, regression analysis, ANOVA, and factorial designs.

syllabi.outline: ‘Statistics’ is the art of using data to make appropriate (sometimes, best!) conjectures about problems encountered. This course is a calculus-based introduction to statistics, and so designed to help students learn the introductory descriptive and inferential statistical procedures that are used in diverse areas. Mainly, this course deals with the basic concepts of statistical inference and linear models. After a review of descriptive statistics and some necessary probability distributions, interval and point estimation, hypothesis tests, linear regression analysis, ANOVA, and factorial designs are illustrated and accompanied by practical/theoretical exercises.

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

syllabi.outline:
1. 啟發學生透過本課程，提昇行業識圖的能力。
 2. 訓練學生如何開列各種材料清單與簡單估價。
 3. 訓練學生建構行業的加工流程。
 4. 建構學生了解行業製造的結構與生產模式，增加從事行業的基礎能力。
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段 （1-4週）
1.	第一週說明課程大綱並安排製作實務分組，每組5人以內
2.	本學期增加簡易收納盒製作與硝化棉系列漆料的使用。
 3.  簡易收納盒建議使用抽屜側板成料來加工，也是噴漆實作的樣品。
 4.  製作產品主題是以雙斜(複斜)為要求的K/D『座具』。
 5.  透過資料收集與歸納的期初PPT報告決定製作之產品。
第二階段 （4-10週）
1.	透過簡易收納盒製圖、修正、定案、開材料單、製作…等細項分工，來讓組員
了解量產工廠製造的分工。
 2. 針對木工製作實務較弱同學，透過團隊合作訓練及補強基礎的加工能力。
 3. 簡易收納盒第四週三視圖定案、第七週製作完成第、八週噴漆教學。
 4. 製作產品主題，請各組透過三視圖，開出正確之淨料、加工、毛料，三種用途
    的材料單，溶入PPT之內容。
 5. 第十週組別K/D『座具』PPT報告並期中考核，以製作貢獻度、配合度與學習
    精神…為主；包括組員評等考核(簡易收納盒之製作)及主題產品定案檢討。
第三階段 （11-16週）
1.	第十一週各組K/D『座具』開始進料與加工任務之安排。並邀請專家演講讓學
生了解工廠的運作內容包括：企劃、生管、品管、砂磨、組立、塗裝、包裝…等措施。
2.	針對製作家具產品，安排所需的生產方式，請同學紀錄實際的照片融入期末
PPT報告中。
 3. 第十六週進行開列產品製作的生產流程之檢討
第四階段期末PPT報告及作品考核（17-18週） 
1.	PPT之考核內容包括定案及組員三視圖各項料單(淨料、加工、毛料)各組員分配零件加工流程特色內容介紹…等。
 2.作品考核內容包括：尺寸精密結構密合完整性特色…等項目。
注意事項：
1.	本課程的目標是學習量產工廠的認識、結構、K/D方法…等，偏製造方面需求的
方向；而非創意設計方面的發揮，希望各位同學能了解與配合！
2.	上課操作機械時，請按照規定配戴安全靴、 護目鏡、耳塞、口罩以避身體在
無保護之下受到傷害。
3.	上課操作機械時要特別注意安全，沒有學習過或不熟悉的機器，一定要請老師
教導安全操作方法，否則不得使用該機械。
4. 上課操作機械時，同學一定要穿長褲、短袖、長袖要捲起、上衣要扎入褲子
   內、長髮要盤起來、最好穿上工作服，以策安全。
5. 上課時，工廠內只允許白開水，不得需帶飲料食物等；違反規定的同學警告、
   登記、扣分。
6. 上課時，不得暄嘩、髒話以影響使用機械的同學；違反規定的同學警告、
   登記、扣分。
7. 幹部、熱心服務、早到…等，酌予加分。
8. 有意申請獎學金同學，要先備案，不接受臨時要求加分。
9. 以上由各項紀錄、幹部學生建議、老師三方面決定。

description.zh: 本課程由ERP概論談起，介紹完整的ERP架構及涵蓋的模組，以及企業規劃及導入ERP的過程，最後結合案例介紹、並探討從ERP到企業的e化等主題，期許同學完成本課程後能了解並運用ERP。
description.en: This course begins with a brief introduction of ERP, followed by a comprehensive discussion on the system architecture, functions, and modules of ERP. Also covered in the course is the process of planning and introducing ERP in enterprises. Real-world cases of ERP and e-Business will be provided in the course.

syllabi.outline:
國內外多數製造業、流通業等均已導入企業資源規劃系統（ERP），唯企業或系統開發商深感E化人才難尋，而園區廠商及一般企業對ERP人才需求殷切，故開設本課程。本課程之開設目的有三：
(一)訓練學生畢業後從事企業財務會計、生產、倉管、採購等部門之ERP系統操作、導入及開發工作。
(二)培育學生未來於資訊系統開發時，對企業流程有完整認識，提升系統開發的效能。
(三)輔導學生考取ERP初階規劃師證照。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：
課程與證照說明， ERP簡介

第2週至第14週:
由海量業師授課,包含以下單元並實際操作海量雲端ERP系統
Unit 1企業資源規劃簡介: 課程與證照說明，ERP的定義、演進及基本概念。
Unit 2 企業流程管理與ERP：說明企業再造與企業經營流程。
Unit 3 銷售與配銷模組：說明銷售與配銷之定義、流程及應用。
Unit 4生產規劃與控制：生產規劃與控制之定義、流程及應用。
Unit 5 企業之採購管理：管理之定義、流程及應用採購管理流程。
Unit 6 庫存管理系統：庫存管理之定義、流程及應用。
Unit 7 財會作業流程：財會作業之定義、流程及應用
Unit8 成本控制模組：成本控制之定義、流程及應用。

第十五週：ERP模組匯整,
第十六週：ERP導入程序
第十七週：ERP個案(協易機械)
第十八週： 期末證照考試

The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

description.zh: 本科目將由不可壓縮流體在各種流動環境所產生之流體分子流動現象之認識，進而利用各種有關因次群，熟習包含可壓縮流體在內之實際應用上所必須具備之基礎方法；如雷諾數．伯努力方程式等。利用流利基礎分析，流體機械之流場與動力，及管路內流場與壓力之變化。
description.en: Introduction to flow phenomena of incompressible flow, discussion on the dimensionless groups and their applicants, derive the conservation equations such as the Bernoulli equation, using fluid mechanics to analyze the field and the dynamics of fluid machinery, pipe and duct flow are also discuss.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:

This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.en: The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The course includes probability theory, testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹國際金融市場以及金融系統。本課程涵蓋範圍包含: 股票市場、貨幣市場、債券市場、外匯市場、房貸市場、投資銀行、保險產業、基金市場…等。主要目的在讓學生了解整個金融市場是如何運作。同時以個案討論方式讓學生對整體的金融市場與機構有通盤的了解。
description.en: This course introduces the international financial markets (i.e. money market, bond market, stock market, mortgage market, foreign exchange market, investment banks, commercial banks…etc). The objectives of this course are to develop a fundamental understanding of (i) how financial markets work; (ii) how financial systems affect people and daily life.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要介紹資訊系統在目前數位時代的公司所扮演的角色，課程介紹內容涵蓋：資訊系統基本理論與實務、電子商務、ERP、供應鏈管理系統、顧客管理系統、資訊安全、資料探勘、商業智慧、人工智慧、工業4.0等熱門趨勢議題。資訊服務被廣泛應用在各個不同領域以及產業，本課程適合任何想對資訊系統有進一步瞭解的同學。上課方式為教師授課、實務操作，並兼以同學分組課堂報告及討論為主。

本課程目的有三：
(一)	訓練學生畢業後從事資訊管理相關領域之執行、導入及開發的工作。
(二)	建立學生對總體數位科技環境的認知，提升未來職場技術能力及觀念性技能的開發。
(三)透過分組討論、實務操作及資料分析，學習基礎知識以及評估未來更多創新的資訊應用模式。

description.zh: 值此一網際網路和數位經濟時代，資料通訊與網路已經顯著影響企業經營、管理及決策與策略規劃同時也影響人們之生活及活動。 它的應用非常廣泛、無所不在且多元。 商業公司及企業可以運用資料通訊及網路化資訊系統來提升競爭優勢及執行績效、經營者決策及客戶服務效率與全球化商務、產品及服務。資料通訊可以在各種設置上以有線及無線的方式使用。因此，本課程的開課目標旨在學習並瞭解資料通訊及網路之基本原理、基礎建設、技術、管理及企業應用等之議題。本課程主要探討之主題包括 1)資料通訊基本原理、2) 資料傳輸技術、3)網路應用、4) 有線及無線區域網路、5) 有線及無線廣域網路、6)網際網路與TCP/IP、7) 網路安全、8)網路設計、9) 網路管理、10)分散資料處理、 11) 主從、內部網路與雲端運算、12) 第四代行動網路和往後世代等。
description.en: In this era of Internet economy, businesses and enterprises may leverage data communications (DC) and networked information systems to enhance competitive advantages, streamline managerial decision making, and customer services. DC may be adopted in a variety of devices on both wire and wireless modes. Consequently, the objectives of this course aim to study the issues of fundamentals, infrastructure, technologies, management and business applications on data communications and networks. The major topics of this course contains 1) Fundamentals of DC, 2) Technologies of data transmission, 3) Network applications, 4) Wired and wireless local area networks, 5) Wired and wireless wide area networks, 6) The Internet and TCP/IP, 7) Network security, 8) Design networks, 9) Network administration; 10) Distributed data processing, 11) Client/Server, Intranet, and cloud computing, 12) Fourth generation (4G) Mobile networks and onwards.

description.zh:
由於雲端運算的快速發展，大量資料收集與儲存技術已成瓶頸，大數據技術與管理提供一套具延展性與容錯能力的分散儲存與計算架構, 能有效處理大量複雜數據資料的儲存與運算。
本課程除介紹現有的大數據生態與趨勢，並針對目前軟硬體架構的處理瓶頸，提供系統組態與部署、服務層級協定、監控與管理等系統性規劃的解決方案，並導入跨領域的工程管理科學知識。課程簡扼論述大數據技術與管理的重要，並在Hadoop生態系統中，以Cloudera Hadoop為應用範例，實作說明其重要性。
課程內容包括：大數據的概念、應用生態與趨勢、Hadoop硬體規格與基礎架構規劃、叢集組態與部署、叢集服務層級協定、叢集監控與管理、相關生態技術、及概略介紹Hadoop認證與準備。
description.en: The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment,YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling and configuration, and Hadoop certification program, etc.

syllabi.outline:
This is a science applied course that examines how the application of big data is made for our human to enhance technical and functional capabilities and how the big data processing efficiency can be facilitated and monitored to achieve well-defined objectives.

As it is well known that an optimized result made by Artificial Intelligence (AI) could not be significantly achieved without big data feedings. Nowadays, there are diversity of data type (mostly of non-structured ones) spreading on the air and pipelines, furthermore we are generating much more data and faster than ever before, and the application of big data does impact our daily life. Although we can store and process the data, there are problems using existing techniques to accommodate our most interests. For example, both accessing the data from disk in distributed systems and getting data to the processors are of the typical bottlenecks. 

This course is designed to not only introduce students to Hadoop Big Data application and trend, but also its processing technology and ecosystems which are capable of eliminating the bottlenecks by its unique methods for storing and processing data per common application scenario. In addition, the course provides the platforms for students’ paper reading, group discussion, co-work assignment, case studies and presentation.

The course will introduce Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major listed below:

	Big Data in Demand and Its Application Trend
	Core Technologies of Hadoop for Big Data Management 
	Management tool to simplify Hadoop Administration  
	Hadoop Cluster Deployment
	YARN Applications including MapReduce  
	Hadoop Cluster Hardware and Software 
	Deployment of Hadoop Ecosystem Projects: Sqoop, Flume, Hive and Impala 
	HDFS Configuration for High Availability
	Hadoop Security 
	Cluster Resource Scheduling and Configuration 
	Cluster Monitoring and Management
	Industrial Big Data and Ecosystems Development and Case Studies

name.zh: 結構隔減震及耐震設計
name.en: Seismic Isolation and Earthquake Resistant Design

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹結構如何提高結構物承受地震力之能力，並探討各國有關結構隔減震及耐震設計規範，使同學了解其設計精神所在，更進一步訓練同學建立對於各種結構使用何種設計的判斷能力及設計技術。
description.en: This course introduces the ability of structures to withstand earthquake forces. Also the course will discusses the design codes of structural isolation and seismic design in various countries. The students can understand the design and establish the design principles for various structures design skills.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要在於簡介結構耐震設計觀念與如何利用隔減震來提高結構物耐震能力，並探討國內有關結構隔減震及耐震設計規範，使同學利用實際軟體操作了解其設計過程，更進一步訓練同學建立對於各種結構使用何種裝置的判斷及技術。本課程重點在實務電腦操作與了解基本觀念，無過多之數學與理論。

第7-10週 減震裝置力學理論概要與規範

name.zh: 基礎工程監測及檢測評估
name.en: In-situ Testing and Monitoring in Foundation Engineering

description.zh: 基礎工程施工期間，由於破壞原有的平衡，經常造成土壤或結構物的沈陷，傾斜，龜裂及破壞等，本課程介紹如何藉由監測的量測值，來分析評估基礎工程的安全性，同時也可配合非破壞性檢測的方法，來評估結構或土壤的力學性質，再進而評估安全性。
description.en: This course introduces how to analyze and evaluate the safety of foundation engineering through the measured values of monitoring. Also, it can also cooperate with non-destructive testing methods to evaluate the mechanical properties of structures or soils, and then evaluate the safety.

name.en: Building Information Modeling: Theory and Applications

description.zh: 本課程將以BIM之觀點，介紹國內外建築資訊模型及建築資訊模型案例，包含建築資訊模型及探討BIM之設計與實作，希望學生能夠由設計一個資訊系統開始，瞭解BIM建築資訊系統之架構與應用，進而實際開發一個BIM相關資訊系統，其內容包括：建築資訊模型營建自動化應用，建築資訊模型實務應用，國內外建築資訊模型案例探討，建築資訊模型元件分析與設計，BIM程式撰寫，BIM系統之設計與實作等內容。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is increasingly important for engineering and management applications, functions and decision-making. The course introduces the BIM use, modeling, design, and development of BIM-related application in the lifecycle of construction projects. The course is a combination of lectures, readings, hands-on exercises, homework assignments and a project. The course allows students to develop a BIM-related application suitable to their own research or professional inteests.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為訓練學生計算冷凍空調設備之蒸發器、冷凝器之熱傳與壓損的能力，以提升冷凍空調設備之設計能力。內容包括兩相流之流譜分析與動量方程式、兩相介面之表面張力作用、熱沸騰與冷凝等相變化之基本現象、兩相流之沸騰與冷凝熱傳性能之計算與分析、兩相流之流力現象分析與壓損之計算、蒸發器與冷凝器之熱傳增強技術等。
description.en: This course offers traning of advanced design techniques of evaporators and condensers in the HVAC & R applications.  The subjects in this course are: the two phase flow regime, analysis of momentum and energy equations for two phase flow, method of prediction of pressure drop of two phase flow, fundamental phenomena of condensation and evaporation, calculation of heat transfer coefficient of convective condensation or evaporation, heat transfer enhancement techniques for condensation and evaporation.

description.zh: 本課程針對目前通用之真空系統原理、設計及實務組裝等議題進行說明與分析。將先針對真空系統進行分類說明，並陳述真空系統實務組裝時所要考慮的事項，以及說明真空系統的抽氣概念與設計。真空腔體的設計原理將會詳細說明，並介紹中低真空、高真空及超高真空的系統設計。
description.en: This class explains and analyzes issues concerning the principle, design, and assembly of vacuum systems that are commonly used today. We will begin with the classification of the vacuum system, then goes into the cautions regarding the assembly of the vacuum systems, as well as the concept and design of the air extraction of the vacuum system. We will also discuss the design principles for the vacuum cavity, and the system design for medium-low, high, and super-high vacuum systems.

description.zh:
建築耗能佔有國家整體能源極大之比例，對於社會、經濟及環境等議題具有相當重要之影響。因此，提升建築能源使用效率、降低成本和環境保護之設計要求，對於專業的建築環境控制工程師以及建築師而言，實為責無旁貸之責任與挑戰。
本課程將講授建築設計規劃與空調系統、照明系統、動力系統、建築能源管理系統等環境控制設備之整合節能設計學理、建築節能模擬與分析、以及相關國內外建築節能標準之應用與設計內涵。學生將藉由課堂授課、資料閱讀、討論及專題模擬分析過程中，學習並養成建築節能之創新設計與技術應用。
description.en: Buildings are significant users of energy in a society and their energy consumption has important implications to social, economic and environmental issues.  A challenging task of building professional engineers and architects today is to design and promtote energy efficient buildings in a cost effective and environmentally responsive way.  This course is intended to introduce the energy efficent technologies of building environmental control systems in the sense of integrated planning, and explain the common methods for building energy anaylysis and building energy efficiency standards. description.zh: 本課程目的為訓練學生獲得在太陽熱能系統與製程應用領域上高階智識理論。課程教材含蓋數種太陽熱能轉換系統用以產生電能、熱水、冷暖氣與照明等用途，主要內容包括太陽輻射幾何學、追日型太陽能聚光器、太陽能史特靈發電系統、太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷暖氣系統、太陽能海水淡化、太陽能照明系統等等章節。期使學生未來能實際應用於各種不同太陽熱能轉換系統之規劃與設計。
description.en: This course aims to give graduate student a resource on the advanced principles and application of solar thermal energy system and processes. The material presented in the course covers several technologies for the conversion of solar thermal energy to provide electricity, hot water, heating, and desalination. The course outline mainly includes analysis of solar geometry and radiation, performance of sun-tracking solar concentrating collectors, solar stirling power system, solar water heating system, solar space heating and cooling system, solar optical lighting system. It hops that the student can apply the learned knowledge to the plan and design of many types of variable solar thermal energy system in year to come.

syllabi.outline:
太陽能熱能工程應用，是一門利用太陽能之能量來提供人類能源之科學，太陽能為取之不盡用之不絕，且為乾淨又穩定之來源，在油價高漲且地球環境保護需求日益殷切的今日，太陽能之能源應用，已成為今日最熱門之學科。本學科之教學目標，在使學生了解基本之太陽能轉換為熱能、電能及照明之基本原理，並且經實際之能量轉換過程,以及熱力學之運用, 使學生對以太陽能為熱源之機械設備,如太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷凍空調設備、太陽能發電機、太陽能電池、太陽能照明設備等之應用，作深入之瞭解與認識，並可對相關產品做能量之計算及規劃設計,以使學生日後能為相關產業提供基礎人才。
本科目將由認識太陽、地球與太陽互動關係、地球上太陽能之基本熱輻射理論，結合各種不同形式之利用太陽能源有效裝置，討論太陽能之有效利用方式及相關系統技術。以期在既有太陽能利用技術上，發揮更有效率的太陽能源工程系統設計，奠定未來21世紀太陽能源利用之高效率化基礎。本門課主要為太陽能應用的原理分析及系統設計，課程內容包括太陽熱能系統的熱力熱傳及流體力學分析與系統設計、成本分析(為主)；太陽能光電系統的組成與設計分析(為輔)。

The application of solar thermal energy engineering is a science of using solar energy to provide human energy. Solar energy is inexhaustible, and it is a clean and stable source. Today, when oil prices are rising and the demand for environmental protection is increasing, The energy application of solar energy has become the most popular subject today. The teaching goal of this subject is to enable students to understand the basic principles of the conversion of solar energy into heat, electrical energy and lighting, and through the actual energy conversion process and the application of thermodynamics, to enable students to understand mechanical equipment that uses solar energy as a heat source, such as solar energy. In-depth understanding and understanding of the application of water heaters, solar refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, solar generators, solar cells, solar lighting equipment, etc., and energy calculation and planning and design of related products, so that students can provide for related industries in the future Basic talents.
This subject will discuss the effective use of solar energy and related system technologies by understanding the sun, the interaction between the earth and the sun, and the basic thermal radiation theory of solar energy on the earth, combining various effective devices for using solar energy sources. It is hoped that in the existing solar energy utilization technology, more efficient solar energy source engineering system design will be used to lay the foundation for the high efficiency of solar energy source utilization in the future 21st century. This course is mainly for the principle analysis and system design of solar energy applications. The content of the course includes thermal heat transfer and fluid mechanics analysis of solar thermal energy system and system design, cost analysis (mainly); composition and design analysis of solar photovoltaic system (secondary)

1~2、微粒討論及潔淨技術基本原理。
分別對空氣污染物質與潔淨技術、氣態化學污染物及其影響、氣態分子污染
物濾除技術做介紹。

分別對過濾器的特性、濾速及面速空氣過濾器過濾的原理以及過濾器的性能

分別對國際及各國潔淨室組織及技術規範、潔淨室的設計條件及潔淨室的設
計程序作說明。

按不同用途分類、氣流組成、空氣循環方式以及潔淨室佈局作講解。
8~9、無塵室的建築規劃
說明實務上無塵室規劃、人員及物料淨化路線、及人員安全問題。

介紹空調箱組成原件、配置方式並說明控制方法。
17潔淨室省能方法探討
分析導體廠能源消耗之特徵以及節省能源之方法。
潔淨室相關標準並分析規範差異性。
18. Final Exam.

name.zh: 技職教育倫理專題研究
name.en: Special Topic on the Ethics of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh:
教學內容包含：學術倫理、教師專業倫理、學校行政倫理、校務研究倫理、評鑑倫理、資訊倫理與科技倫理、及其他新興倫理議題。
課程實施方法以講解、專題演講、專題討論及情境問題解決為主。研究生探討主題可針對當前技職教育領域倫理相關重要課題，挑選有興趣之子題提出簡報，進行小型研究問題的探討與實作，並提出心得報告於課堂中研討，或撰寫探究議題之相關學術論述，以發展研究能力。
description.en:
The contents of this course include: academic ethics, professional ethics for teachers , administrative ethics, institutional research ethics, evaluation ethics, information ethics and ethics in technology as well as other emerging issues on ethics.
Lecturing, keynote speeches, seminars, and situation problem solutions are the means to be conducted in class. Students can report on sub-issues  in current ethics-related fields in technological and vocational education, investigating and implementing small-scale study, reviewing and proposing related topics, or writing academic papers, for the purpose to develop strong research skills and abilities.

課程實施方法以講解、專題演講、專題討論及情境問題解決為主。研究生探討主題可針對當前技職教育領域倫理相關重要課題，挑選有興趣之子題提出簡報，進行小型研究問題的探討與實作，並提出心得報告於課堂中研討，或撰寫探究議題之相關學術論述，以發展研究能力。

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。
syllabi.schedule:
1.課程介紹
2..技職教育的理念
3.技術在歷史中的演化
4.技職教育哲學(一)
5.技職教育哲學(二)
6.Edgerton的技術史觀
7.中國古代科技思想對技職教育的啟示
8.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（一）1945-1965
9..戰後台灣的技職教育發展（二）1966-1987
10.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（三）1988-迄今
11.全球化對技職教育研究的啟示
12.其他技職教育史哲相關文獻評論

一、平時成績：每週指定文獻閱讀及討論40%

2.針對該主題對「技職教育」影響主持討論活動。
三、期末書面報告30%，依據期中口頭報告增刪，將修正後將電子檔寄給老師

name.zh: 教育訓練需求評估與規劃

description.zh: 教育訓練是人力資源的一環，本課程探討教育訓練的種類及評估訓練需求的方法與程序，並了解人力部門在規劃員工訓練計劃之前，如何對員工進行調查以確實地掌握員工的需求及意願，同時亦能掌握企業之發展目標。
description.en: Educational training is part of the human resources. This curriculum will discuss the categories of educational training and evaluate the methods and procedures of the training needs, and understand how the human resource department investigates the employee's needs and will, and know the development aim of the enterprise as well before the planning of the employee educational training program.

name.en: Career Planning and Management for Employees

description.zh: （一）瞭解生涯規劃與經營的理論及實務；（二）探討生涯規劃與經營模式；（三）應用生涯規劃與經營模式。課程內容包括：生涯規劃與生涯管理的定義、內涵與功能、生涯探究指引、生涯目標設定、生涯策略、生涯評估、生涯管理議題、人力資源支持系統及組織生涯管理系統。
description.en: The course arms to (1) Understand the theory and application Of career planning and management. (2) Explore the model of career planning and management. (3) Apply the career planning and management model. It covers the definition, essence, and function of career planning and management, a guide to career exploration, career goal setting, career strategies, career appraisal, and contemporary issues in career management, human resource support system, and organizational career management system.

description.en: This course is designed for students who have taken one-year undergraduate organic chemistry course. It is divided into the three fundamental aspects of the study of organic chemistry:reactions, mechanisms and structure. A student who has completed this course should be able to approach the literature directry, with a sound knowledge of modern basic organic chemistry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教導學生具備獨立思考有機化學的能力;因此課程分為基本觀念(結構式與鍵結),有機化學反應與反應機構以及化合物的製備與分析等三大部分。
The aim of this course is to educate students to think independently about organic chemistry. The course is divided into three parts;introductory material(concepts of structure and bonding);organic reactions and mechanism(sigma-bond chemistry followed by  pi-bond chemistry);and topics of more specialized interest.

description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing . Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are devided into the following units :
(I)Fundamental Studies:(a)Transport Phenomena (b)Viscoelastic Properties of  Polymer Melt (c)Polymer Compounding and Blending.
(II)Practical Studies:(a)Compression Molding (b)Injection Molding (c)Reaction Injection Molding (d)Fiber Formation (e)Membrane
      Formation.

syllabi.outline:

(1) 黏彈性簡介(2)時間溫度轉換(3)非結晶區之玻璃轉移點(4)橡膠理論
(5)黏彈模型(6)射出成形(7)吹膜成形(8)擠壓成形(9)熔融紡絲(10)塗佈工藝等專題。

description.zh: 課程兩個主要目標為光譜學方法及分離方法。光譜學方法內容含紫外、可見、紅光、核磁、x-ray等光譜法。電子譜及質譜也將被討論。分離方法方面有液層、氣層、膠層等層析法。分離後串聯之光譜分析也會學習。
description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. description.zh:
景觀生態學是以生態學理論來理解並建立一套可以認知景觀與其中的生物﹑非生物環境關係的學科。有關景觀的生態設計理論基本上是將這一系列景觀生態學模型或原理作為設計指標而形成的一套設計操作理論。景觀生態原理在景觀學科中具有極其根本的角色，不僅在景觀資源保育與管理上提供極具價值的參考；對於景觀規畫與設計實務者更提供了在不同尺度範疇狀況下三向度空間設計的形態準則。
因此，課程涵蓋了從區域、基地和細部設計三種尺度的設計內涵，講述及操作在基於不同目的的需求時，人為景觀如何介入自然環境，以及導入的人為景觀的設計準則。
1. 景觀生態與形態理論
2. 景觀生態設計理論
3. 景觀生態設計理論的應用 
   a. 都市地區和鄉村地區     
   b. 區域、基地和細部設計尺度
description.en:
Landscape ecology seeks for principles and models that contribute to dealing with conservation, management, and design in landscape practice. The course "Landscape Theory and Practice of Ecological Design" refers to those principles and models established in landscape ecology and then applies to landscape planning and design. Issues relates to this courses are listed as follows;
1. Landscape Ecology and landscape morphology
2.  Ecological design theory
3.  The application of ecological theory in landscape         practice 
    a. Urban region and countryside     
    b. Macro-sale, meso-sale, and micro-scale

syllabi.outline:
本課程係以生物多樣性保育及其對現代設計理念的跨領域思考為主軸，說明地表重要生態體系的功能與結構，及其所蘊育的生物，在物種演化、環境適應與生活史策略上的特色，輔以國內外案例介紹，探討如何將生態體系的運轉模式與永續理念，有效整合到人為工程的規劃、設計、施作、乃至後續監測維護過程中。此外，並將深入剖析近代動物園與水族館設計理念的發展，及討論既有公共工程，如道路、橋樑、護坡、農田水圳、攔水堰等設計，對環境與生物的影響，另搭配臺北近郊的生態工法案例介紹與研擬討論，期能激發同學對相關議題的興趣與實務經驗。
	This course will be focusing on biodiversity conservation and multidisciplinary thinking on modern design concepts. The functions and structures of important ecological systems on earth, and the organisms inhabit with their evolution, adaptation and life history strategies will be introduced. With domestic and foreign cases, how to effectively integrate the operation mode and sustainable concept of the ecological system into the planning, design, construction, and subsequent monitoring and maintenance of human engineering will be discussed. In addition, the development of modern zoo and aquarium design concepts, or the impact of existing public construction works, such as roads, bridges, slope protection, farmland canals, and weirs, to our environment will also be involved in a hope to stimulate students' interest in related topics and practical experience.

This course is aimed to involve the students into the project of University Social Responsibility. From interview, observation, documentation to design, the students are expected to explore the diverse value of architectural profession and to practice the social responsibility by applying their expertise to solve real-world problems. In specific, the process will engage the members from the aboriginal tribes into a series of participatory activities, including site analysis, programming, design development, and collaborative construction.

name.en: Special Topics on Sustainable and Resilient Cities

description.zh: 該課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略；內容包括永續城市、創意城市、智慧城市、宜居城市、全球城市和後工業城市的各種概念。課程將引導學生參與學術性討論和永續與韌性的城市發展實務理解；提供在不同經濟、體制和文化環境下，探索其規劃政策和設計概念，並以實際案例借鑒不同城市之韌性的回復力規劃，以及說明如何促進城市韌性回復能力，減少社會失序和提高當地應變災害能力的積極策略，因此課程的目標包括讓學生參與永續城市發展的學術討論和韌性城市實踐方法，發展相關知識與了解促進韌性城市和永續性的國際實踐案例，期能將這些概念和經驗應用於規劃設計所需的研究和技能。
description.en: The course will examine strategies for sustainable and resilient urban development in the globalization and climate change. It will engage students in academic discussions and the practice of sustainable and resilient development. Planning policies and design concepts will be explored in different economic, institutional and cultural environments. Case studies draw on best practices in urban resilience planning in different cities, and will illustrate positive strategies to promote urban resilience, reduce social disruption, and improve local ability to deal with pressure. The objectives are to engage students in sustainable urban development, develop knowledge and understand good international practices that promote urban resilience and sustainability, and develop the research and skills necessary to apply these concepts and ideas to actual planning projects.

syllabi.outline:
韌性城市是人類回應環境變化以尋求新穩定狀態能力的集居聚落。由於全球氣候變遷逐漸影響人類的居住環境，加以城市的開發與發展，消耗的能源與資源，促使碳排放增加，破壞自然界的循環，又導致氣候變遷的速度加劇；台灣位處自然災害容易發生之脆弱帶，將近3/4面積與人口處於地震、颱風與洪患之複合性災害威脅地區，必須積極推動減緩與調適作為。研究顯示藉由建構永續與韌性機制及基盤設施系統，可提升自身轉化、重組之功能，有效因應環境變化，因此建構韌性城市已成為建築、都市與環境規劃重要的研究議題。
本課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略與行動方案；內容包括永續、創意、智慧、宜居、全球和後工業城市的理論與實務；並以實際案例借鑒不同城市之韌性的回復力規劃，減少社會失序和提高當地應變災害能力的積極策略和實踐方法，期能將這些概念和經驗應用於規劃所需的研究和技能。

description.en: Facing a trend toward the aging society, the issue about the elderly and environment is supposed to be valued. description.zh:
1. 授課目的：  現代都市計劃及都市設計作業內容中，必須考量都市永續環境生態之議題。本課程之目的即在於傳述都市之生態概念在規劃實務上之應用，並探討其作業技術內容及其行政程序，以培養學生永續都市及敷地計畫規劃能力。

2. 授課內容：  由基本永續都市中，思考生態環境、人類生活環境及建築之間的相互關係。綠建築、永續都市之內容。引介各項生態技術原理及其指標講授，進而指導實證操作技術實驗並撰寫論文，再而論證其都計管制規範。

3. 作業練習：  本學期藉由實驗操作、論文報告撰寫，特別著重研討式論辯，訓練學術思辯及技術應用規劃能力，以利學生認識都市生態技術及都計行政作業之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位規劃思辯能力。

description.en: Information gathering skills are essential to the studying of graduate students and the development of their subject knowledge on dissertation/thesis writing. The content of the course will deal with the broad principles and practices underlying information gathering techniques which explore the many practical tools and electronics sources of information that will help graduate students find the information they need when doing research or writing the dissertation/thesis.

description.zh:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：
一.疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。
二.家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。
三.醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。
四.日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include:(1)Immunology: to introduce the interactions between the immune system and the factors of sick building syndrome (SBS) and some specific pathogens.(2)Behavioral science: to investigate the influence of dietary and habit changes on environmental and human health.(3)Medical care: to introduce the difference and the response strategies between sick building syndrome (SBS) and Multiple Chemical Sensitivity (MCS)(4)Daily life: to investigate the influence of daily articles and resident behavior on environmental and human health.

syllabi.outline:
Healthy Building Environment（2）

The main goal of this course is to built environment that encourages positive well-being of human beings. This course will introduce the healthy building and environment that between human health and the built environment and to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Different factors in a building affect its safety and hygiene. The factors such as lighting, quality of air, thermal comfort, aural comfort, colors, mind, movement, water , Nourishment ,materials ,and community are known to have a positive relationship with a healthy built environment.
The course will be conducted in the following main topics.

A. Air Quality：To achieve high levels of air quality across a building’s lifetime through diverse strategies that include source elimination or reduction, active and passive building design and operation strategies and human behavior interventions.

B. Materials: to reduce human exposure, whether direct or through environmental contamination, to chemicals that may impact health during the construction, remodeling, furnishing and operation of buildings.

C. Thermal Comfort：To promote human productivity and provide a maximum level of thermal comfort among all building users through improved HVAC system design and control and by meeting individual thermal preferences.

D. Light : create lighting environments that promote visual, mental and biological health.

E. Sound : the identification and mitigation of acoustical comfort parameters that shape occupant experiences in the built environment.

F. Movement and Fitness: promotes physical activity in everyday life through environmental design, policies and programs to ensure that movement opportunities are integrated into the fabric of our culture, buildings and communities.

G.mind: promotes mental health through policy, program and design strategies that seek to address the diverse factors that influence cognitive and emotional well-being.

H.Water : All aspects of the quality, distribution and control of liquid water in buildings.

This course introduces the main sub-disciplines, key issues and research trends in Applied Linguistics/Literature and Culture. It aims to provide graduate students with the fundamental knowledge and guidance needed for preparing and writing a research paper.

Students will come to my office to discuss matters related to researching and preparing and MA thesis, including the Taipei Tech library databases, library cataloging systems (Dewey Decimal and Library of Congress), NTU Library resources, Metacat (searching all the university libraries in Taiwan), and the resources and links for students on my website. We will discuss the general timeline for the proposal and thesis submission. We also will discuss plagiarism and patchwriting (https://britamericanlit.wordpress.com/plagiarism-and-patchwriting/) and do a self-quiz on both.
syllabi.schedule: Four groups of students will meet with me once. They will meet with other professors on other weeks.
syllabi.assessment:
Students who are attentive throughout the session and ask good questions will receive between an 88–92 for our meeting. Students who have obviously prepared in advance may receive a higher grade, and students who seem less prepared or who are unable to hold a discussion with me and ask questions may receive a lower grade.

All students must also complete a short proposal, following the stipulated guidelines, which one of the professors will grade. Students should be especially careful to cite their sources correctly and to avoid patchwriting and plagiarism.

description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 英語語用學的研究關乎了解英語在各種情境下的使用。本課程首先回顧一些最常用於理解「言外之音」的重要觀念，例如「暗示」、「預設」、及「言談行為」。下個階段則是介紹一些重要語用學的議題，例如「禮貌理論」、「修辭語」、「言語幽默」、和「機構性談話」，並概述用於研究這些語用學議題的一些方法，包含「會話分析」、「言談分析」、甚或「批判性言談分析」。本課程旨在透過充足的英文例子來提升學生的語用學意識，從而鼓勵他們發揮語用學的知識來應對各種(英文)語言的實務操作。
description.en: The study of English pragmatics is about understanding the use of English in different types of context. The course begins by revisiting the ideas most commonly embraced to understand meaning beyond the linguistic code (e.g. implicature, presupposition, speech act). The next step is an overview of the key issues in pragmatics (e.g. politeness theory, figure of speech, verbal humor, institutional talk) as well as the various approaches to these issues (e.g. conversation analysis, discourse analysis, and critical discourse analysis). This course aims to raise students’ pragmatic awareness with ample English examples, and encourage them to apply pragmatic knowledge in various aspects of (English) language practices.

description.zh: 本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

name.en: User Experience Design ＆ Interdisciplinary Collaborate Innovation

description.zh: Innovation Design Workshop (IDW)是UDDC華冑設計整合美國GE公司、IDEO公司、史丹佛大學、卡內基美隆大學、荷蘭飛利浦公司等學術與業務單位，應用於產品與服務創新上，一系列的「使用者情境體驗導向、跨專業合作創新」方法，以市場策略導向的「使用者情境體驗」工作營方法進行創意激盪，引領企業邁入前瞻性規劃，激發新產品與服務創新價值，帶動產業之永續創新。藉由跨領域團隊協同共融，從工作營中洞悉、觀察及體驗使用者需求，找尋創新脈絡及契機，以有紀律、有效率的方式，策略性的激發產品創新概念。 使用者導向的情境體驗法，為21世紀知識經濟時代針對產品、設備及服務，以宏觀時空環境及微觀使用者生活型態、生活行為為導向，從事產品創新設計研發的方法。在產品、設備與服務系統設計開發前及過程中，以情境預演與觀察的方式，從使用者的角度，先行訂定產品策略、市場定位，界定使用者特質，思想模式及生活情境，進而以體驗設計模式，進行使用情境的預想、觀察、分析，並將設計構想透過情境模擬體驗，驗證所設計的產品、設備與服務，是否能真正符合消費者與使用群族的需求。
description.en: Provide a great opportunity to practice interdisciplinary collaborative design in product innovation. Encourage more flexible design approach that creates new innovative product value (innovalue) and emerging market perspectives. Using「user-oriented innovative design process」into this collaborative practice, in order to develop a broader range of design concept directions. Strategy Mapping & Positioning _ Competitor product analysis Design Feature Attribute Mapping (Scope/Target User/Quantity/Product & Design Definition)

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

syllabi.outline:
瞭解生命週期思維(Life Cycle Thinking)與生命週期管理(LCM)對環境問題解決的重要性；學會生命週期評估(LCA)的原理及方法，並學會如何評估產品每個生命週期階段的環境及社會衝擊；學習LCA的軟體操作及其應用；學會應用LCA來解決環境問題及政策制定，包括產品環境化設計、碳足跡及碳標籤等。
To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most important tools for analyzing and assessing environmental problems will be taught during the course of the semester. Students will also be learning a popular LCA software, SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as carbon footprinting and labeling, and eco-design will also be practiced in the class.
syllabi.schedule:
1.	生命週期評估概論－I (Introduction of Life Cycle Assessment I)：歷史、發展與應用(history, development, and application)
2.	放假一周
3.	生命週期評估方法論概要－I (Methodology of LCA- I)：目標範疇界定與盤查分析(Goal and Scope definition and inventory analysis)
4.	生命週期評估方法論概要－II (Methodology of LCA- II)：盤查分析與軟體操作(inventory analysis and software, Simapro)
5.	生命週期評估方法論概要－III (Methodology of LCA- III)：衝擊評估方法學(methodology of LCIA)
6.	生命週期評估方法論概要－IV(Methodology of LCA- IV)：衝擊評估方法學(methodology of LCIA)
7.	放假一周
8.	生命週期評估方法論概要－VII(Methodology of LCA- VII)：不確定性、敏感度分析與闡釋(uncertainty, sensitivity analysis and interpretation)
9.	期中考(Mid-term Exam)
10.	分組報告－完成一項產品/服務的LCA
11.	其他類型的LCA (other LCA)：生命週期成本、社會生命週期評估與組織生命週期評估(Life cycle costing (LCCs), social LCA, and organizational LCA)
12.	LCA 應用(LCA Applications)：環境宣告與標籤(environmental declarations and Labels)
13.	LCA 應用(LCA Applications)：綠色製程、產品設計與發展(Green Processes, Product Design and Development)
14.	LCA 展望(LCA outlook)：
15.	Special Topic: 碳足跡、淨零及碳中和(Carbon Footprinting, Net Zero and Carbon Neutrality)
16.	Special Topic: Natural Capital Accounting and LCA
17.	專題報告－分組簡報Team Project Presentation
18.	專題報告－分組簡報Team Project Presentation

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.
syllabi.schedule:
1	2/21	生命週期評估概論－(Introduction of Life Cycle Assessment)：歷史、發展與應用(history, development, and application)
2	2/28	放假一周/228
3	3/7	生命週期評估方法論概要－I (Methodology of LCA- I)：目標範疇界定與盤查分析(Goal and Scope definition and inventory analysis)
4	3/114	生命週期評估方法論概要－II (Methodology of LCA- II)：盤查分析與軟體操作(inventory analysis and software, Simapro)
5	3/21	生命週期評估方法論概要－III (Methodology of LCA- III)：盤查分析、資料庫與衝擊評估導論(inventory, LCI database, introduction of LCIA)
6	3/28	生命週期評估方法論概要－IV(Methodology of LCA- IV)：衝擊評估方法學(methodology of LCIA)
7	4/4	放假一周
8	4/11	生命週期評估方法論概要－VII(Methodology of LCA- VII)：不確定性、敏感度分析、闡釋與Open LCA 說明(uncertainty, sensitivity analysis, interpretation, and introduction of Open LCA)
9	4/18	期中考(Mid-term Exam)
10	4/25	生命週期評估補充說明－(Supplementary of of LCA- II)：歐盟環境足跡(EU Environmental Footprint)
11	5/2	其他類型的LCA (other LCA)：生命週期成本、社會生命週期評估與組織生命週期評估(Life cycle costing (LCCs), social LCA, and organizational LCA)
12	5/9	LCA 應用：溫室氣體盤查與範疇三評估實務：GHG protocol 與ISO 14064-1: 2018
13	5/16	LCA 應用(LCA Applications)：環境宣告與標籤(environmental declarations and Labels)，ISO 14025與EN 15804 A2+
14	5/23	LCA 應用(LCA Applications)：綠色製程、產品設計與發展(Green Processes, Product Design and Development)
15	5/30	LCA 展望(LCA outlook)：LCA趨勢與未來
16	6/6	Special Topic: Natural Capital Accounting and LCA
17	6/13	專題報告－分組簡報Team Project Presentation
18	6/20	專題報告－分組簡報Team Project Presentation

name.zh: 能源轉型與低碳社會建構

description.zh: 21世紀國際為確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展，國際紛紛採取氣候變遷相關因應措施，低碳化已成為全球之共同趨勢。本課程將介紹能源轉型/節能減碳與低碳經濟及社會之國際趨勢、國際溫室氣體減量與能源安全相關法規、我國溫室氣體減量與節能相關法規等，並介紹碳足跡、碳中和等概念，由國際相關案例看我國邁向低碳經濟與社會挑戰與機會。
description.en: To ensure the sustainable development of environment, economy and society, effective measures are gradually adopted by internationals. Low-Carbonization obviously becomes a global common tendency. This course will be introduced the international tendencies of “energy saving & carbon reduction” and “low-carbon society”. It will also be introduced with related regulations of international greenhouse gases reduction, energy security, Taiwan GHG reduction, energy saving. The above concepts and latter concepts of carbon footprints and carbon neutral will be introduced with international practical cases to refer to challenges as well as chances toward a low-carbon Economy and society in Taiwan

description.zh: 生物電化學可以獲得更多先進的訊息，其中包括生化反應、形態學，以及物理、化學和電學等相關性質。運用相關的技術方法，例如電化學工具，可用以研究異相與均相反應，亦可獲得諸多界面間的化學活性和圖譜以利用於微裝置的發展。對生物分析而言，生物電化學感測器具有最大的再現性，並能夠成功的引用於電活性生化物種、母體材料，以及其規格上。生物電分析方法包括最先進和有用的方法，其中大部分皆建立在此領域的的基礎上。
description.en: Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. For bioanalysis, bioelectrochemistry sensors have maximum reliability and can be successfully employed in electroactive biomaterials, matrix materials, and their size. Bioelectroanalysis include descriptions of the most advanced and successful methods, which in large part build on the fundamentals will be described.

syllabi.outline:
生物電化學可以獲得更多先進的訊息，其中包括生化反應、形態學，以及物理、化學和電學等相關性質。運用相關的技術方法，例如電化學工具，可用以研究異相與均相反應，亦可獲得諸多界面間的化學活性和圖譜以利用於微裝置的發展。對生物分析而言，生物電化學感測器具有最大的再現性，並能夠成功的引用於電活性生化物種、母體材料，以及其規格上。生物電分析方法包括最先進和有用的方法，其中大部分皆建立在此領域的的基礎上。
Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. For bioanalysis, bioelectrochemistry sensors have maximum reliability and can be successfully employed in electroactive biomaterials, matrix materials, and their size. Bioelectroanalysis include descriptions of the most advanced and successful methods, which in large part build on the fundamentals will be described.

description.zh:
在推動國家經濟發展，提升環境保護和創造國家競爭力，政府對於科技政策之擬定，及科技經費之持續支持十分重要，並以此培植科技人才、將科技研發成果加以推廣。為確保有限之科技資源能夠發揮其最高之效用，建立客觀及公正之績效評估制度實屬必要。本課程擬以最近影響人類生活環境甚巨之全球暖化現象( Global Warming )，及其引發之綠能科技投資為例，探討綠能科技政策之擬訂，以及綠能產業經濟分析。
綠色能源包括風能、太陽能、生質能、氫能與燃料電池、地熱能、海洋能與淨煤技術，發展綠能產業即具備「3E」平衡發展之功效，已成各國追求之目標。
本課程預計將涵蓋以下主題：
替代能源介紹（包括生質能源，如生質柴油與酒精汽油，以及氫能與燃料電池等）
再生能源介紹（包括太陽能、風能、水力發電、地熱及海洋能等）
二氧化碳捕捉與封存、淨煤專題
LED專題等
description.en:
Many scientists conclude that the increased greenhouse effect is already accelerating global warming and leading to the climate change. Worldwide government are taking measures to tackle this issue and outlining strategies to bring the greenhouse effect under control.
Greenhouse gas emissions in Taiwan are mainly from burning fossil fuels such as crude oil, coal and LPG and the energy imports have reached 99.22%. Therefore, the sustainable development in any country is to increase the proportion of self-generation of energy, reduce the emission of GHGs, and balance among Economic Growth, Environment Protection and Energy Supply.
Green energy (Renewable energy) covers the fields of solar and wind energy, biofuels which includes biodiesel and bioethanol, hydrogen energy and fuel cell, geothermal and ocean energy as well as clean coal combustion technologies (IGCC). Balancing development of '3E' can be achieved by developing green energy industries and which is also the goal every count

description.zh: 本課程主要以實務案例之解析為內容，並結合商標法理論剖析之教學方式，來深入介紹我國商標實務上之重要爭議，讓同學了解司法實務中，如何具體適用法律、判決或學說等。此外，本課程亦將分別介紹國外相關學說理論及著名司法案例，期望同學透過本課程之修習，來培養對國內外商標法案例思辨及評析之能力。
description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

syllabi.outline:
商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論之探討，讓同學能夠深入對商標法之瞭解。
Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

name.zh: 數位匯流與智財法律專題(二)
name.en: Intellectual Property Laws in the Age of Digital Convergence(II)

description.zh: 在數位匯流的趨勢下，網際網路不但即將成為各種傳統媒體的聚集之處，同時也不斷衍生新型態的媒體傳播方式。有鑑於此，本課程目的即在探討數位匯流時代的智財法律議題。將由實際案例為主，輔以相關分析文章及法律規定的解析，帶領同學了解數位環境的特性、數位媒體形式與媒體內容的發展，同時針對著作權、隱私權等實用智慧財產權議題，讓同學了解、並具備分析數位時代的媒體趨勢、以及智財法律策略的能力。
description.en: In the face of digital convergence, the internet seems will not only become the ultimate channel for all kinds of traditional media, but the birthplace of new types. In light of the challenges posed by the digital age, this course is aimed at helping students explore the IP legal issues with reference to the media evolution on the internet. It will begin with the introduction of the characteristics of the internet, the developments of the digital media formation and content, and followed by the discussions and analysis on the cases in the real life.

syllabi.outline: The aim of this course is designed to help students of diversified background to have a comprehensive understanding of the impact of digital technology towards IP laws. The topics of this course include(but not limited to)  IP protections of online content and the evolving legal framework of intangible data. Students will acquire their research skills by case discussions and knowledge of IP legal development  in the changing cyberspace.English proficiency shall be a plus  to students upon completion of this course.
