description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，須考慮消費者對新創事業產品(新創產品)之瞭解及接受程度。如果能在創業之初對消費者進行新創產品之消費者行為調查，可使新創事業在成立之初即找出目標顧客群，並分析出目標顧客的消費偏好，例如：對新創產品的品質要求、功能偏好、購買可能金額、消費通路類別等，創業者可依所瞭解目標顧客的消費偏好，規劃適當的行銷方案，而提高創業成功的機會。
description.en: Entrepreneurs should consider consumers’ understanding and acceptance of new products (innovative products) in their new ventures. If a start-up company conducts consumer behavior survey in the beginning, the new business is able to identify the target customer base from the start, and analyze the target consumer preferences, including quality requirements, functional preferences, amount of possible purchase, types of consumer access. By understanding target consumer preferences, entrepreneurs can plan appropriate marketing programs, and improve business opportunities for success.

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

syllabi.outline:
本課程採用由 Google 團隊原創、MIT 麻省理工學院維護的 App Inventor 2 中文版為工具，透過拖拉積木組接式的雲端開發環境，讓即使沒有任何程式設計基礎的學生，也可以輕鬆透過組合的方式，開發出各式各樣、有趣實用的 Android App。
App Inventor 2 將各種功能以動態積木拼圖的形式呈現，省去記誦程式語法的步驟，大大降低了學習的門檻！讓你能快速開發出簡易的 App，同時隨著人工智慧盛行，也可以利用 Personal Image Classifier (PIC) 元件，親自體驗動手玩 AI。
syllabi.schedule:
第01週 App Inventor 2 概述及開發環境建置
第02週 App Inventor 2 基本操作與手機連結
第03週 基本元件以及事件、方法使用
第04週 事件驅動與條件判斷
第05週 介面配置與繪圖元件
第06週 迴圈與副程式
第07週 Web 網站資料擷取和語音元件
第08週 互動介面與觸控操作
第09週 期中測驗
第10週 社交應用與微型資料庫
第11週 定位與地圖元件－垃圾車開到哪
第12週 條碼掃描應用－LBS 行動導覽範例-1
第13週 條碼掃描應用－LBS 行動導覽範例-2
第14週 多重畫面與方向感測器應用－氣球遊戲範例
第15週 雲端資料存取－課堂表決器範例-1
第16週 雲端資料存取－課堂表決器範例-2
第17週 人工智慧 PIC 元件－猜拳辨識器
第18週 期末測驗

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的是教授學生區塊鏈技術的基本概念與應用，激發學生在區塊鏈領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 區塊鏈概論、區塊鏈的基本工作原理、區塊鏈安裝、智能合約製作、設計思考、區塊鏈與物聯網、區塊鏈的金融應用、區塊鏈的產業應用、區塊鏈與人工智慧
description.en: This course is to teach students the basic concepts and applications of blockchain technology and to inspire students for innovative blockchain applications. The course includes: blockchain introduction, blockchain working principles, blockchain installation, smart contract development, design thinking, blockchain and internet of things, financial applications of blockchain, industrial applications of blockchain, and blockchain and artificial intelligence.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

description.zh: 歷史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，不論是史料或新舊的研究著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為史學著作的經典。這些書籍既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，中西歷史、古往今來的風物民情、地貌變遷等流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解人類的歷史。
description.en: Since the study of the history has been in prosperity, a large number of historical texts have been newly translated and interpreted, thus gaining more importance. These texts can be categorized as classical volumes of history . There have been existent a lot of other written resources interesting and meaningful exhibiting the vivid image of the people, geography, folk stories and the transition of time available in history. This course focuses on these particular materials concerning the human history through the discussion of which, the history of mankind can be better understood.

syllabi.outline: 台灣史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，有許多的著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為台灣歷史書籍之經典。言以經典未沉重，令人望而生畏。還有一些書籍，是既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，數百年台灣風物民情地貌變遷流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的台灣歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解台灣歷史。

description.zh:
面對科技發展日新月異，社會急驟變遷的新世紀，只習得專業上的一技之長，已不足以和協圓滿地實踐有意義的人生。有鑑於此，乃以生涯發展與生涯諮商的理論與研究為基礎，配合學生的發展，希翼能透過教育的歷程，使學生的專業知識能和未來的工作與生活規劃，產生有意義的聯結，進而為學生提供一個短程與長程的生涯發展與選擇的準備與指引。
授課內容包括生涯理念介紹、興趣、性格、價值觀探索，生
涯決定因素，生涯技巧，生涯角色調適，生涯選擇與規劃技
巧，生涯訪談，生涯高原調適，轉型期調適，性別、職業歧
視，雙生涯家庭，就業準備等主要生涯課題的研討與習作。
description.en: In face of a new century with continuous scientific development and rapid social changes, to learn one single professional skill is not enough to fulfill a meaningful life in a harmonic and satisfactory manner. In view of this, based on the theory and research of career development and consultation in association with the development of students,  it is hoped to produce a meaningful linking between their professional knowledge and job and life planning through the course of eucation, and further to provide them a preparation and guide for short and long-range career development and choice. The contents of the course include the discussion and exercise related to major career topics such as introduction to the concept of career, the discussion of interest, character and value, decisive factors of career, skills of career, role adjustment in career, career choice and planning skill, career interview, uphill adjustment in career, adjustment in transit period, sex and occupation.

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

description.zh: 本課程主要在使學生明瞭中國及西洋人生哲學的歷史發展，並介紹人生哲學的內在涵義，分別探究人的意義、特性、人性論、真善美聖等問題；兼及人生哲學的當代意義：包括各種人生觀、生命的尊嚴、愛與婚姻及修養等探究。使知、情、意能融為一體，藉以確立個人理性的生命追尋目標。
description.en: The purpose of the course is to enable students to realize historical development in Chinese and Western philosophy of life by introducing the inner connotation of philosophy of life and studying the issues on the meaning and characteristics of life, humanism, virtue, good and beauty, etc..  Furthermore, this course introduces the meanings of philosophy of life in relation to the contemporary life, such as various kinds of philosophy of life, dignity of life, love and marriage, moral cultivation. It aims to integrate knowledge, passion and intention, for setting up the goal that personal rational life should pursue.

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

syllabi.outline:
主軸：美好關係探索
本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的心理學理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、自由書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導學生自我建構內心安頓和關係發展的力量。
(PS.非心理學理論課程，亦非單向式講授，屬生活應用與實踐性質。)

name.en: Cross Strait Relations and International Politics

description.zh:
本課程由全球化框架來檢視兩岸關係的演進、現況、及發展趨勢。
由政治、經濟、乃至社會心理層面分析海峽兩岸錯綜複雜的互動關係。
並檢視國際政治經濟體系中，美國與日本兩大國對兩岸關係的影響。
description.en:
This introductory course on the complex cross-strait interactions will examine
Taiwan’s role in the intricate web of international power politics; as well as the structure of hegemonic power rivalry, particularly Sino-US-Japan triangle, and its impact on cross strait relations. The material will cover the evolution, status quo, and developmental path of the cross strait relations in a global framework.

syllabi.schedule:
課程進度：
一	課程總論：兩岸關係的現實和國際政治的關鍵要素
二	大國政治的悲劇：美國的戰略布局與修昔底德陷阱
三	中美博弈：科技與貿易角力
四	中美博弈：軍備競賽、島鏈之爭
五	國際政治的現實：中美霸權如何相互抗衡? 
六	國際政治的現實：世界亞洲化趨勢
七	國際政治的現實：國際供應鏈的移轉可能嗎?
八	區域經濟整合趨勢下的台灣
九	期中考週
十	以全球視野揭露中國戰略佈局
十一	高度發展的中國經濟與軍事：從粵港澳大灣區到北斗系統
十二	兩岸關係的本質：一張圖道盡兩岸現實
十三	兩岸經貿、產業關係與全球化：依賴？競爭？脫鉤？剝削？雙贏？
十四	兩岸關係與台灣政黨政治、民意趨勢、認同政治
十五	端午放假
十六	中美台三角戰略互動：棋手與棋子的視角
十七	結論：國際政經舞台上，台灣命運劇本結局何去何從？ 
十八	期末考週

description.zh: 運動、營養與健康是目前先進國家相當關注之理念與課題，也是提升生活品質與開發個人潛能的有效方法。本課程將有系統的介紹健康的生活方式與規律適度的運動，並將著重於如何將運動學與營養學之學理與技術，適當應用於個體健康生活整體之營造，使修課學生能了解運動前後的均衡飲食與擁有健康。
description.en: Exercise, nutrition and health is very concerned about the idea of advanced countries and issues, but also an effective way to develop individual potential and quality of life improved. This course will introduce a healthy lifestyle with moderate exercise system of law, and will focus on how the theoretical and technical kinematics and nutrition, the proper individuals applied to create a healthy life as a whole, so that students can enjoy the sport taught , and have a healthy balanced diet.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 本課程之目的在使同學對於創業財務管理之專業知識產生一概略的認識，期望同學能瞭解資金之運用、籌措及管理之一些觀念及技巧，並做為未來進行相關財務決策或進一步研究財務理論之基礎。本課程會將攸關財務的主題加以介紹,包含：1.財務報表分析2.時間價值，債券與股票3.投資決策與折現分析4.風險、報酬與資金成本5.公司融資政策6.資本結構與股利政策7.財務規畫8.合併與購併。

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

syllabi.outline:
「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
    在眾多的生活科學群中，生活美學是一支新秀。它把美學用到生活的考察和研究之中，從審美的角度分析和揭示生活環境營造和社會生活發展等方面的規律，以生活的美和空間特有的審美關係作為自己的研究對象，力求揭示生活空間美的創造規律和法則，分析生活空間的美化與生活空間的各項功能要求的關係，研究空間使用者的審美心理和審美教育問題，從而達到提高空間美的創造和感受能力，促進空間美化的目的。

name.en: Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage

description.zh:
我國古蹟與歷史建築之文化遺產防災計畫實施現況，至今因欠缺有系統之調查研究，因此難以了解問題點所在。此外台灣現有之古蹟與歷史建築多為日治時期所遺留下來，而日本至今已有相當多具有良好防災計畫之古蹟與歷史建築案例，應可作為我國相關研究參考，但國內對此課題亦缺少有系統之調查。
本課程的授課內容如下：1.概論 2.文化遺產防災之重要性3.文化遺產防災之基本策略4. 文化遺產防災之進行方式5.文化遺產之災害種類與對策。
description.en:
Due to the lack of systematic research work carried out in Taiwan, it is difficult to find out the problems of the current disaster prevention plans for the cultural heritage. Taiwan has many existing vestiges and relics from Japanese colonial period at the moment. Despite the fact that there are numerous excellent examples of disaster prevention plans in Japan for us to consult and to research, little systematic work regarded the subject can be found in the literature in our own country. 
The course content about followings: 
1. Introduction
2. Importance of disaster prevention of cultural heritage
3. Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage 
4. Approach of disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage
5. Type of cultural heritage disaster and guideline

Students are expected to learn the followings in English: (1) Terminologies commonly used in management; (2) Draft and write-up of English memorandum; (3) Development of meeting materials such as agenda, motions, minutes, etc.; (4) Business proposals and plans; and (6) Contemporary topics and trend in global management issues. description.zh:
「民事訴訟法」第一個部分，此部分旨在向修課同學作民事訴訟法之概括介紹，而此一介紹包含下列三個重點： 一、民事訴訟法之立法背景 二、民事訴訟法之理論 三、民事訴訟法之解釋方法 參與此部分乃理解民事訴訟法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
第二個部分，此部分會聚焦在民事訴訟法之細節上，尤其是下列三個重點：
一、對於民事訴訟法之進一步闡述
二、民事訴訟法於案例事實之適用
三、民法與民事訴訟法之結合
於此部分課程結束時，修課同學應有能力依據民事訴訟法來處理常見之民事法律問題。
description.en:
“Civil Procedure Law” the first part of this course, is aiming to give participants a general introduction to the Civil Procedure Law, and the introduction contains the following three points: 1. The legislative background of the Civil Procedure Law. 2. The theories of the Civil Procedure Law. 3. The interpretive methods of the Civil Procedure Law. Attending the part is the critical step to understanding the Civil Procedure Law and benefits participants a lot.
The second part of this course, is focusing on the details of the Civil Proce-dure Law, especially the following three points: 
1. Further elucidation of the Civil Procedure Law.
2. Application of the Civil Procedure Law to the facts.
3. Combination of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
At the end of the part, participants are supposed to be able to deal with common civil legal problems according to the Civil Procedure Law.

syllabi.outline:
不論是一般之契約或車禍事件，或者是跨國之高科技侵權案件，我們生活中之大小事均與民事訴訟程序息息相關，無論是否從事法律業，皆有學習民事訴訟法之必要，以維護自己的權益。本課程即旨在以淺顯易懂之方式，介紹民事訴訟法之基礎理論及規範，並輔以案例來加以說明，俾使修課同學能對於民事訴訟建立基本之了解，並進而能作初步之實務應用。
本課程除了民事訴訟法的規定本身外，也會教授相關的民法規定，故即使無民法基礎的同學亦歡迎修課。

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

二、教學目標：期使同學於期末，能對現今專利法制的重要觀念與趨勢，能有普遍性的認識與瞭解。

description.zh: 刑法是規定犯罪與刑罰之法律，例如「殺人」是犯罪，「處死刑、無期徒刑或10年以上有期徒刑」是刑罰。刑法總則是規定各種犯罪與刑罰之共通原理，例如故意或過失。刑法分則是規定各種不同的犯罪與刑罰，例如（故意）殺人或過失致死。透過刑法分則課程之修習，希望使同學能夠認識刑法常見而重要的犯罪類型之規定。
description.en: Criminal law is a law that stipulates crime and punishment. For example, "homicide" is a crime, and "punishment for death, life imprisonment or more than 10 years in prison" is a punishment. The general rule of criminal law is to stipulate the common principles of various crimes and penalties, such as intentional or negligent. The criminal law is to stipulate various crimes and penalties, such as (intentional) murder or negligence. Through the training of the Criminal Law Sub-Course, I hope that students can understand the provisions of the common and important types of crimes in criminal law.

syllabi.outline:
刑法是規定犯罪與刑罰之法律，例如「殺人」是犯罪，「處死刑、無期徒刑或10年以上有期徒刑」是刑罰。刑法總則是規定各種犯罪與刑罰之共通原理，例如故意或過失。刑法分則是規定各種不同的犯罪與刑罰，例如（故意）殺人或過失致死。透過刑法分則課程之修習，希望使同學能夠認識刑法常見而重要的犯罪類型之規定。
Criminal law is a law that stipulates crime and punishment. For example, "homicide" is a crime, and "punishment for death, life imprisonment or more than 10 years in prison" is a punishment. The general rule of criminal law is to stipulate the common principles of various crimes and penalties, such as intentional or negligent. The criminal law is to stipulate various crimes and penalties, such as (intentional) murder or negligence. Through the training of the Criminal Law Sub-Course, I hope that students can understand the provisions of the common and important types of crimes in criminal law.

description.zh:
數據無處不在。隨著真實世界和數位世界交互影響，越來越多的設計決策有望得到數據分析的支持。本課程旨在培養設計師的數據素養技能。首先介紹對個性化產品和服務的需求，是如何從認知及情感面來創造更好的使用者經驗，並將數據資訊轉換為產品知識/服務設計/系統決策。大部分課堂時間將以研究導向的設計專題方式進行。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.區分批量生產及個性化設計
2.了解如何將數據科學納入設計流程

4.應用合適的工具/軟體來解釋小型或大型數據集
5.了解在設計過程中使用數據的倫理與關鍵原則

description.zh:
設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.描述設計方法的演變
2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異
3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制
4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程
5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en:
Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.
Upon completing this course, you will be able to:
1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies 
2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer   
3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology
4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part  
5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

description.zh:
本課程主要探討界面的物理化學現象及其在高科技之應用。包括有
(1) 表面及界面張力的分子理論(2)界面的作用力(3)表面及界面的熱力學(4)液體和固體界面的熱力學(5)表面及界面張力的測量(6)接觸角的測量(7)吸附的熱力學(8)分散液的穩定性(9)分散液分子間吸力及斥力(10)懸浮液之高分子穩定性(11)凝聚(12)界面科學在高科技及光電工業上之原理及應用。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the interfacial phenomena and its application in high-tech Industries. It includes (1)molecular theory of surface and interface (2)molecular interaction of interface (3)thermodynamics of surface and interfaces (4)thermodynamics of liquids in contact with solids (5)measurement of surface and interfacial tension (6)contact angle measurement (7)thermodynamics of adsorption (8)stability of dispersion (9)molecular interaction of dispersion (10)stability of suspension (11)flocculation(12)application of interface science in High-tech industries

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

description.zh: 3D列印又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)。
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以實務為主，學生需要學習擠製成型(ME)、光固化聚合(VP)、材料噴印(MJ)與粉床融合(PBF)等類的三維列印機的設計原理。首先將以熔融擠製成型類的三維列印機兩種機構設計的拆卸與組裝，再透過機台的校正後，列印出可接受的品質物件。第二種為DLP類的光固化聚合三維列印機，透過軟體的教學帶領學生考慮支撐建構的原則與列印方向對列印品的差異性比較。第三種為Object的材料噴印三維列印機，透過機台的使用可以了解噴印的原理，並建構較為細緻的特徵。第四種為選擇性雷射金屬燒結列印機，讓學生可以了解晶格結構對機械性質的影響等。

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

description.zh: 作業研究是用來處理將有限資源分配於許多競爭性活動的問題上之一種有用的技術，它已經變成眾多企業工業機構的一種標準工具。基於線性規劃的基本知識高等作為研究提供一些有及可靠的運等方法來所決非線性規劃問題及機率模式。一些與實際應用有關的課題諸如有貨理論、等程理論、可靠度及決策理論等將在本課程中以討論。
description.en: This course discusses linear programming, network analysis, dynamic programming, game theory, (non) integer programming, Markov chains (Markovian decision process), queuing theory, inventory models, forecasting models, decision analysis and simulation.

syllabi.outline: 作業研究是用來處理將有限資源分配於競爭性作業的一種技術，高等作業研究課程主要在基於線性規劃等作業研究基本知識上，如何探討以數量模式求出相關作業問題之最佳解，並介紹學生瞭解作業研究的本質，數量規畫方法及機率型態問題等。課程內容包括線型規畫、運輸與指派問題、網路分析、專案管理、整數規畫等主題並就作業研究相關個案及研究文獻進行探討。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹企業進行國際化策略以及多國籍企業營運與其功能性（價值鏈活動）之議題。期使學生瞭解當代企業國際化營運的重要性與其內涵，並建立整體的概念。同時，藉由精選案例之探討，提供學習者了解企業進行國際化與國際營運管理相關的實務作法。如此，將使學習者得將國企理論與概念運用於實際案例，培養分析能力。
description.en: The course is mainly for the students to understand the importance of international business strategies of MNC (Multi-Nation Company) which includes the business models, value chain and the functionality. In the mean time, the students will have a clear picture of MNC's daily operation by well-selected case study. The ultimate goal is to apply the theory into the real business world and to have an advanced analysis capability at the end of the course.

name.en: Elective  Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Culture

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生的人文素養。透過文學概論、藝術概論與文化概論等相關課程，引導學生探索文學的妙趣，欣賞藝術的美質，瞭解文化的傳統。從古典到現代，從本土到世界，從物質到心靈，建構多元化的文化視野。以臺灣為出發點，搜尋未知的世界地圖，找到人們必然駐足的角落，以及自己不可缺席的人文風景。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to enrich the literary taste and the cultural cultivation of our students. Though the related course, like Introduction of Literature, Introduction of Art and Introduction of Culture, we hope to guide the students to explore the interest of the Literature, to enjoy the beauty of the Art and to understand the tradition of the Culture. From classic to modern, from local to universe, from material to spirit, we want to construct multiple cultural views. Taking Taiwan as a start, we would search the unknown map of the universe, and would find a corner for consequential staying and one's own liberal scenery.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to enrich the literary taste and the cultural cultivation of our students. Though the related course, like Introduction of Literature, Introduction of Art and Introduction of Culture, we hope to guide the students to explore the interest of the Literature, to enjoy the beauty of the Art and to understand the tradition of the Culture. From classic to modern, from local to universe, from material to spirit, we want to construct multiple cultural views. Taking Taiwan as a start, we would search the unknown map of the universe, and would find a corner for consequential staying and one's own liberal scenery.

name.en: Elective Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。
description.en: This course focuses on getting the students familiar with the academic field of history in a more comprehensive and systematic view. The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some  courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

Further, they are guided to select some  courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

name.en: Elective Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。

name.zh: 設計思考-設計與永續發展

description.zh:
設計思考是一種幫助人們理解與發展解決特定問題的創造性方法，
在本課程中，我們將聚焦在如何使用設計思考方法解決聯合國可持續發展目標中所遇到的問題。
課程採用教學與工作坊模式，希望能啟發與培養同理心、問題解決能力、溝通與協調能力、透過跨域共創，培育未來跨領域領導人才。
description.en:
Design thinking is a methodology that helps people understand and develop creative ways to solve a specific issue.
In this course, we will focus on how to use Design thinking method to solving problems in UN SDGs.
the course hopes to inspire and teaching students have Empathy, problem solving ability, communication and coordination ability, and foster future cross-disciplinary leaders.

Design thinking is a methodology that helps people understand and develop creative ways to solve a specific issue.
In this course, we will focus on how to use Design thinking method to solving problems in UN SDGs.
the course hopes to inspire and teaching students have Empathy, problem solving ability, communication and coordination ability, and foster future cross-disciplinary leaders.

配合本校苗圃計劃
本課程為北科北醫跨校合作課程【設計思考-設計與永續發展X領導力與創新管理】，校內選課同學組成小組(2~3人一組)後，會與北醫小組合併，形成5~6人的團隊，共同進行本課程的工作坊與期末團體報告。故歡迎對於跨域組成團隊共同合作有興趣與熱情的同學選修，若對於跨校組成團隊互動討論意願低者，請勿選修本課程。 
(如因疫情影響，將調整為線上授課教學模式)
syllabi.schedule:
W01_02/25(五)34- Design Thinking-Design for SDGs / 課程規畫&介紹  Introduction

W02_03/04(五)34- What is Design Thinking/論定義與方法應用

W03_03/15(二)ABC- Design thinking Workshop-I / 6:30-9:50pm

                 木酢達人創辦人演講&QA	
                 (如因疫情空間人數限制，老師們與講者實體，學生線上)

W04_03/18(五)34- Stakeholder / Who is main stakeholder?

W05_03/22(二)AB- Design thinking Workshop-II
                 設計思考-設計與永續發展工作坊-II 
                 Brainstorming / What is Brainstorming? 
                 (移地教學: 臺北醫學大學跨領域學院1F)
              
W06_ 03/26(六)1~C - Design thinking Workshop-III / 8:00am-9:00pm
                   設計思考-設計與永續發展工作坊-III (移地教學:金山) 
                   SDGs這件事、淨灘體驗、場域踏查

W07_ 04/08(五)34- Holiday / Qingming Tomb Sweeping Day 清明節

W11_05/07(六)2~9- Design thinking Workshop-IV
                  設計思考-設計與永續發展工作坊-IV
                  Idea Exploration 、 Rough & Fast Prototype

W15_06/03(五)34- Final Presentation  

W17_06/18(五)34- 課程回顧與展望 繳交期末個人報告
syllabi.assessment:
1. 期末發表 Final Presentation 35% 
2. 團隊合作 Team Work 40%
3. 個人表現 Personal performance 10%
4. 心得報告 Experience report 15%
syllabi.materials:
1. Change by Design, Revised and Updated: How Design Thinking Transforms Organizations and Inspires Innovation. Tim Brown (Author)
2. 設計思考改造世界 Change by Design: How Design Thinking Transforms Organizations and Inspires  Innovation, 提姆．布朗 Tim Brown, 吳莉君譯, 聯經出版公司, 2010/09/01
3. 設計思考全攻略 The design Thinking Playbook,Larry Leifer、Micheal Lewrick, Patrick Link, 周宜芳譯,天下雜誌, 2019.10
4. 自編講義
5.UN SDGs
syllabi.notes:
1.本課程將以北科i學園plus做為課程網頁

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

syllabi.outline:
本課程欲讓學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

name.en: Special Topics of Instrumental Analytical Chemistry

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

syllabi.outline: This course will be concerned with the theory and the applications of instrumental methods for the qualitative and quantitative analysis of chemical substances including solid materials. The technical backgrounds and design of UV-Vis, ICP-AES, AA, FT-IR, XPS/Auger electron spectroscopy, SEM/AFM and TGA/DTA/DSC will be introduced in a semester.

name.en: Elective Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。
description.en: This course focuses on getting the students familiar with the academic field of history in a more comprehensive and systematic view. The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some  courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

description.zh: 本課程旨在闡明中國傳統思想之精義，疏通其中所涵蘊之問題，希望透過講授與討論，把握中國思想發展之大脈，並展望未來文化之發展。在課程設計方面，依序分先秦諸子、魏晉玄學、隋唐佛學、宋明學、近代思想五大綱領。深入淺出，直探本源，使學者領會中國歷代哲人之睿見，指引人生步上光明之大道。
description.en: This course deals mainly with the essence of Chinese traditional thought, trying to sovle the riddles lying behind the msytery of Asian philosophy. Through lectures and class discussion, students are expected to have a better command of the significant stream of thinking development for the Chinese people and look into the future cultural development. As for the course planning, this course consists of the following five topics: Pre-Chin philosophers, Taoism in Wei and Jin Dynasties, Buddism in Sui and Tang dynasties, Confucianism in Song and Ming Dynasties and modern philosophy. The course will be presented with simple approaches and lots of class discussions in the hope that  students will realize the wisdom explored by important philosophers throughout Chinese history, which will in returen provide students with much more promising and enrihed way of life.

syllabi.outline:
Course description: This course is intended as an introduction to some of the key concepts and ideas in Chinese Philosophy. Through reading of some of the most influential texts of main thinkers, students will develop a general understanding of Chinese philosophy and how these may relate to contemporary life. This course will not assume any previous knowledge in the area. All reading and discussions are in English.
Requirements: The course is conducted in English and demands active participation. Students are expected to contribute actively to class meetings by posing questions and by responding to the questions and comments of other students based on the material in lectures and readings. Students are asked to establish small groups and to conduct analysis on related project and give an oral presentations before the final exam.
（全英語授課）

name.zh: 互動媒體設計專題講座

description.zh: 為掌握產業界的技術新知、學術界的專業研究、藝文界的脈動等，本課程講座將廣邀互動媒體設計的專家或學者，參與專題討論，就互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術等面向，分別以宏觀的政治、社會、文化、科技、環境等角度剖析，另以微觀角度深入個案研究作探討，藉此議題討論互動媒體設計的現況與未來發展趨勢。教學評量將以各項的主題式討論報告為主。
description.en: To understand science and technological information from business, professional research from academic and issues from art and cultural fields, the seminars on interactive media design should be invited these fields of expertise and scholars to participate the topic discussion. With the macro-perspective of politics, social, culture, technology and environment, the seminar focuses on the dimension of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art. Besides, the seminars explore case studies with micro-perspective to discuss interactive media design existing and future development. The assessment includes thematic discussion and final report.

description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

Course takers are in addition to developing technology-oriented doctoral level academic theory, but also has practical experience in the industry, to become a highly specialized personnel with practical professional skills.

name.en: Elective  Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Philosophy

description.zh: 哲學既是一門兼具理想性與現實性的基礎學科，又是一種既有趣又深刻的一種思想活動。 它所探討的目標都是和人類自身與他們所生活的周遭世界密切相關的一些基本問題；這些基本問題至少包括：宇宙、知識、公平正義、道德、宗教、語言、心靈、社會、教育、愛情，和生與死。 從事哲學思考，就是對上述問題，進行一種反省。 這種反省，能夠讓我們明白形成這些問題背後的一些基本原則，以及解決這些問題的一些可能方案的理由根據和獲致這些解決方案的應有程序。 由於哲學是著重思考與反省的活動，學習哲學其實不僅僅可以幫助我們掌握和人類自身與生活世界相關問題的一些根本知識，更能培養一個負責任的社會公民不可或缺的一種思維能力和反省態度。
description.en: Philosophy is not only a fundamental subject with both ideals and practical value, but also an interesting thinking activity of depth.  The topics it discusses concern some basic questions for we human beings and the world around us.  These basic questions at least include: the universe, knowledge, equality and justice, morality, religion, language, mind, society, education, love, and life and death.  Thinking things philosophically is to reflect upon these basic questions.  The reflection of this sort leads us to understand not only the basic principles behind these questions,   also the reasons and procedures of the possible solutions to these questions.  Given philosophy is such an activity based on thinking and reflection, learning philosophy hence can help us grasp the required knowledge concerning ourselves and our living world, and more importantly, prepare a thinking ability and reflecting attitude that are needed for us to succeed in becoming responsible social citizen.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期到工業工程與管理相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the industrial engineering and management related fields in one of the corporative industrial engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative industrial engineering and management company full-time at least 4.5 months.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用學期間至相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業企業之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation in one of the corporative company during curriculum session, practice and learn the real operation of the ing related fields . A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

syllabi.assessment: 本課程住要針對即將畢業的學生，其在學理上有一定基礎，並重點培養學生系統性的思維，跳脫單一專業領域並具備異質系統整合的能力，且能應用現代資通訊技術來發展鐵道領域的維修與運務的創新服務。

description.zh: 碩士學位論文寫作
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授並彙交所屬系所保存。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to provide graduate students with an opportunity to gain practical experience. During either the summer/winter break or regular semester, students are required to go to the institutions approved by their thesis supervisors to participate in the on-site research. The course takers need to stay in the same institution no less than 320 hours, and to present research documents issued by the on-site institution to their supervisors. This document will be collected and stored in the Office of Graduate Institute of Automation Technology. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site institution (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 論文寫作
description.en: Thesis writing.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

name.en: Internship of practical technology research and development

description.zh: 本課程之目的為讓技術導向博士班學生於學期間至本所各分組專業相關之企業、政府單位或具規模之其他機構從事全職實務技術研發工作，讓技術導向博士生除發展學術理論外，更擁有業界實務經驗，以成為學養精湛且具有實務技能之高階專業人才。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the technique-orientated Ph.D. students . During the semester, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry / business-oriented agencies working as a full-time R & D practical job. Course takers are in addition to developing technology-oriented doctoral level academic theory, but also has practical experience in the industry, to become a highly specialized personnel with practical professional skills.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期至電子工程相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 
 
In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在修完學期校外實習(一)之後，在畢業之前希望能獲得較長期體驗車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation after semester practical training (1). Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 

In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities, and submit to their instructors for approval. With instructors’ approval, they need to make registration to the departmental office for application by the end of the add/drop course selection weeks of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期至土木工程相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業機構之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the civil engineering related fields in one of the corporative civil engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative civil engineering company full-time at least 4.5 months

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。

The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site.
